route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Needs 32 quest points. Dialogue: “Can I have a quest?”.

Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville. Dialogue: “Can you sell me a rune platebody?” → “The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.” → “I thought you were going to give me a quest.” → “A dragon, that sounds like fun.”.

route.title: The Guildmaster's questions
steps: Return to the Guildmaster and ask every question in turn: the ship, the shield, Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's map pieces. Asking about Melzar's piece gives you the Maze key.

do.t: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Dialogue: “Can I have a quest?”. You need 32 quest points.
do.s: Guildmaster (Champions' Guild): ask for a quest (32 QP)

do.t: Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville. Dialogue: “Can you sell me a rune platebody?” → “The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.” → “I thought you were going to give me a quest.” → “A dragon, that sounds like fun.”.
do.s: Oziach (Edgeville): ask about the dragon quest

do.t: Return to the Guildmaster and ask every question in turn. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “Where can I find the right ship?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask where to find the right ship

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I protect myself from the dragon's breath?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask how to survive the dragon's breath

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Melzar's map piece?”. He gives you the Maze key.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Melzar's map piece (gives the Maze key)

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster again. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Thalzar's map piece?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Thalzar's map piece

do.t: Ask the Guildmaster once more. Dialogue: “About my quest to kill the dragon...” → “I talked to Oziach...” → “How can I find the route to Crandor?” → “Where is Lozar's map piece?”.
do.s: Guildmaster: ask about Lozar's map piece

route.title: Ground floor: the red key
steps: Enter Melzar's Maze north of Rimmington with the Maze key. Each coloured key opens one door and then crumbles, a wrong door too.
Kill the marked zombie rat for the red Key, open the red door with the floor tile (west wall, north end), then climb the ladder.

route.title: First floor: the orange key
steps: Kill the marked ghost for the orange Key, open the orange door with the floor tile (east wall, second from the north), then climb the ladder.

route.title: Second floor: the yellow key
steps: Kill the marked skeleton for the yellow Key, open the yellow door with the floor tile (south wall, furthest west), then take the ladders down to the basement.

route.title: Basement: blue, magenta and green keys
steps: Kill the marked zombie (blue key), Melzar the Mad (magenta key) and the lesser demon (green key), open the doors and the chest for the map piece.

do.t: Open Melzar's Maze (north of Rimmington) with the Maze key. One right door per floor, marked by a floor tile; a key crumbles in any door it opens. Bring Water, Air and Mind runes: the basement demon is a magic fight.
do.s: Melzar's Maze: open the door (Maze key)

pre.t: Runes for the lesser demon: it is a magic fight

do.t: In the room with the rats, kill the zombie rat the guide marks (level 3, long tail): it drops the red Key.
do.s: Rat room: kill the marked zombie rat (red Key)

do.t: Open the red door with the guide's floor tile: on the room's west wall, at its north end. The other red doors are dead ends and use up the key. "The door is locked" means you have no red Key: kill the marked rat again.
do.s: Rat room: the red door with the floor tile

do.t: Climb the ladder just behind the red door up to the first floor.
do.s: Behind the red door: ladder up

do.t: On the first floor, kill the ghost the guide marks (level 19, hooded, no cape): it drops the orange Key.
do.s: First floor: kill the marked ghost (orange Key)

do.t: Open the orange door marked by the floor tile: east wall, second door from the north. Other orange doors use up the key. "The door is locked": no orange key, kill the marked ghost again.
do.s: First floor: the orange door with the floor tile

do.t: Climb the ladder behind the orange door up to the second floor.
do.s: Behind the orange door: ladder up

do.t: On the second floor, kill the skeleton the guide marks (level 22, small round shield): it drops the yellow Key.
do.s: Second floor: kill the marked skeleton (yellow Key)

do.t: Open the yellow door with the guide's floor tile: on the south wall, the one furthest west. The other yellow doors use up the key. "The door is locked" means you have no yellow Key: kill the marked skeleton again.
do.s: Second floor: the yellow door with the floor tile

do.t: Follow the corridor behind the yellow door to the ladder and climb down.
do.s: Behind the yellow door: ladder down

do.t: Climb down the next ladder, right where you land.
do.s: First floor: next ladder down

do.t: Climb down the ladder into the basement of Melzar's Maze.
do.s: Ground floor: ladder down to the basement

do.t: In the basement, kill the zombie the guide marks (level 24): it drops the blue Key. The brown door here leads out of the maze, not on.
do.s: Basement: kill the marked zombie (blue Key)

do.t: Open the blue door with the blue Key: there is only one.
do.s: Basement: the blue door

do.t: Kill Melzar the Mad (level 43) for the magenta key.
do.s: Basement: kill Melzar the Mad (magenta key)

do.t: Open the magenta (purple) door with the magenta Key.
do.s: Basement: the magenta door

do.t: Magic only: stand one square east of the magenta door, where the lesser demon cannot reach you. Cast Water Strike (Water Bolt from Magic 23) with metal armour off: it cuts magic accuracy to about a fifth.
do.s: Basement: kill the lesser demon (green key)

pre.t: No runes: leave the maze and buy Water, Air and Mind runes

do.t: Open the green door with the green Key.
do.s: Basement: the green door

do.t: Open the chest and take Melzar's map piece.
do.s: Basement: open the chest (map piece)

items.name: Maze key
items.where: From the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild (S5-01). He gives another if you lose it.

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food for the fights: up to a level 82 lesser demon.

items.name: Water rune
items.where: Water Strike for the lesser demon (magic only, from the safespot).

items.name: Air rune
items.where: Water Strike: 1 a cast.

items.name: Mind rune
items.where: Water Strike: 1 a cast.

route.title: The Oracle and the secret room
steps: Talk to the Oracle on top of Ice Mountain.
Go down the ladder in the dwarven camp, then use the four items on the magic door in the north-east of the Dwarven Mine.
Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece.

do.t: Talk to the Oracle on top of Ice Mountain. Dialogue: “I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.”.
do.s: Oracle (Ice Mountain): ask for the map piece

do.t: Go down the ladder in the dwarven camp south of Ice Mountain into the Dwarven Mine.
do.s: Dwarven camp: ladder down to the Dwarven Mine

do.t: Head to the square room in the north-east corner of the Dwarven Mine: the magic door is there. Use the Silk on the door.
do.s: Dwarven Mine: use Silk on the magic door

do.t: Use the lobster pot on the magic door.
do.s: Magic door: use the Lobster pot

do.t: Use the unfired bowl on the magic door.
do.s: Magic door: use the Unfired bowl

do.t: Use the wizard's mind bomb on the magic door. Be careful not to drink it.
do.s: Magic door: use the Wizard's mind bomb (do not drink it)

do.t: Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece.
do.s: Secret room: search the chest (map piece)

items.name: Silk
items.where: Silk trader in Al Kharid, 3 gp.

items.name: Lobster pot
items.where: Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim, 20 gp.

items.name: Unfired bowl
items.where: Soft clay on a pottery wheel (Crafting 8), or buy it on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Wizard's mind bomb
items.where: Rising Sun Inn in Falador, 3 gp.

route.title: Wormbrain in Port Sarim Jail
steps: Pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins for Lozar's map piece in the dialogue.
Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.

do.t: Go to Port Sarim Jail and pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins (Dialogue: “I believe you've got a piece of a map that I need.” → “I suppose I could pay you for the map piece...” → “Alright then, 10,000 it is.”).
do.s: Wormbrain (Port Sarim Jail): pay 10,000 gp

do.t: Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.
do.s: Bag: use the three Map parts together (Crandor map)

items.name: Coins
items.where: Wormbrain takes exactly 10,000 coins.

route.title: The ship
steps: Buy Lady Lumbridge from Klarense on the south Port Sarim docks for 2,000 coins.
Board the ship, go down into the hull and repair the hole three times (a plank and 30 steel nails each).

do.t: Talk to Klarense on the south Port Sarim docks and buy his boat. Dialogue: “I'd like to buy her.” → “Yep, sounds good.”. It costs 2,000 coins.
do.s: Klarense (Port Sarim docks): buy Lady Lumbridge (2,000 gp)

do.t: Board your new ship by the gangplank.
do.s: Port Sarim docks: board Lady Lumbridge

do.t: Go down the ladder into the ship's hull.
do.s: Ship deck: ladder down to the hull

do.t: Use a Plank on the hole in the hull. Each plank takes 30 Steel nails, and a Hammer must be in the bag: 3 planks and 90 nails in all.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 1 of 3

do.t: Repair the hole again: second plank.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 2 of 3

do.t: Repair the hole a third time: last plank.
do.s: Hull: repair the hole, plank 3 of 3

items.name: Plank
items.where: Ordinary planks, bought on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Steel nails
items.where: 30 for each plank: buy 90 on the Grand Exchange.

items.name: Hammer
items.where: Lumbridge General Store, 1 gp.

items.name: Coins
items.where: For the ship: 2,000 coins.

route.title: The map and the captain
steps: Use the three map pieces on each other to make the Crandor map.
Bring the map to Captain Ned in Draynor Village and ask him to be your captain.

do.t: Use the three Map parts on each other to make the Crandor map.
do.s: Bag: use the three Map parts together (Crandor map)

do.t: Bring Ned the Crandor map and ask him to be your captain. Dialogue: “You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?”.
do.s: Captain Ned (Draynor): ask him to be your captain

items.name: Map part
items.where: The three map pieces: Melzar's, Thalzar's and Lozar's (S5-03 to S5-05).

route.title: Sail to Crandor
steps: Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, food and a strong weapon.
Board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim and talk to Ned on the deck.

route.title: Crandor and the volcano
steps: Go to the centre of the island and down the hole.
Go all the way south and through the wall: it unlocks the shortcut from the Karamja volcano.
Enter Elvarg's area and kill her. Her head ends up in your bag.

do.t: Prepare to fight Elvarg (level 83). Do not board without the Anti-dragon shield, plenty of food (lobsters or swordfish), a strong weapon (adamant or rune) and a strength potion. Then board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
do.s: Port Sarim: board the ship (Anti-dragon shield in the bag first!)

pre.t: Get the Anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on Crandor

do.t: Talk to Ned on the deck. Dialogue: “Yes, let's go!”.
do.s: Ship deck: talk to Ned to sail to Crandor

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn before the fight: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70. Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle gives it free (S5-02).

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: bring 20 or more (swordfish are as good).

items.name: Strength potion(4)
items.where: Optional boost: a strength potion before the fight.

do.t: Go to the centre of the island and go down the hole.
do.s: Crandor: climb down the hole in the centre of the island

do.t: Go all the way south and through the wall to unlock the shortcut to the Karamja volcano. Lesser demons (level 82) roam here: keep moving, eat when low. After a death, this is your way back.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: go south and through the wall (shortcut)

do.t: After a death before the shortcut was opened: board Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim, repair the hole in the hull again (3 Planks, 90 Steel nails, a Hammer), then talk to Ned on deck to sail.
do.s: After a death: repair the hull again and sail with Ned

pre.t: Take 3 Planks: the hull needs repairing again
Take 90 Steel nails for the hull
Take a Hammer for the hull
Get the Anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on Crandor

do.t: After a death: re-equip (Anti-dragon shield worn, food, gear), sail from Port Sarim to Musa Point, walk west to the Karamja volcano and climb in. Your shortcut leads back to Crandor.
do.s: After a death: Karamja volcano (south of Brimhaven), climb in

pre.t: Wear the Anti-dragon shield before you go back to Elvarg
Take 20 or more lobsters or other good food: there is no bank on the way

do.t: In the volcano, go north through the wall you opened from the Crandor side, back into the Crandor dungeon.
do.s: Volcano: north through the wall shortcut back to Crandor

do.t: Equip the Anti-dragon shield, then climb into Elvarg's area. Pick the Stab style on the sword, eat below 20 health, and never take the shield off.
do.s: Crandor dungeon: enter Elvarg's lair (shield worn!)

do.t: Kill Elvarg (level 83) with the Anti-dragon shield worn. At low levels the wiki's safer way: flinch her from the south-east corner of her cave. Her head drops into your inventory.
do.s: Elvarg's lair: kill Elvarg (her head drops into the bag)

go.label: Crandor — the hole in the centre of the island

items.name: Anti-dragon shield
items.where: Worn: without it Elvarg's fire hits up to 70.

items.name: Lobster
items.where: Food: 20 or more.

route.title: Finish
steps: Talk to Oziach in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest.

do.t: Talk to Oziach in his hut in north-western Edgeville to finish the quest. Then you can buy and wear the Rune platebody (Defence 40).
do.s: Oziach (Edgeville): finish the quest

route.title: Starting out
steps: To start, talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower. Dialogue: "OK old monk, what can I do?" Note: if he gives you a Watch speak to him again
Go down the ladder in the middle room.
Follow the path to a hub with four doors.

route.title: Obtaining the red cog
steps: Head through the south-eastern door.
Walk down the passageway until you see some Ogres.
Pick up the red cog.
Head back to the ladder.
Climb up to the and use the red cog on the red spindle (located on the column beside the ladder, facing north).

route.title: Obtaining the blue cog
steps: Go outside of the Clock Tower and head east to where Brother Cedric is (South of Ardougne zoo).
Go down the ladder east of Brother Cedric.
Follow the tunnel to the end.
Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog.
Climb up the ladder.
Head to the centre room of the Clocktower and climb the staircase to the .
Use the blue cog with the blue spindle (the spindle on the south side of the column).

route.title: Obtaining the black cog
steps: Head back to the basement and go through the north-eastern door
Use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves to pick up the cog. Make sure to finish the dialogue or you will not pick up the cog.
Head back to the ladder. (Do not climb up the ladder)
Use the black cog with the black spindle. (In the basement of the Clock Tower on the east side of the column).

route.title: Obtaining the white cog
steps: Head through the north-western door.
Pick up the rat poison to the north-west.
Head to the end of the tunnel
Pull the levers up to open the rat cage.
Use the rat poison with the food trough.
Wait until all the rats have died.
Head through the western gate.
Pick up the white cog.
Climb-up the ladder.
Head inside to the top floor.
Use the white cog with the white spindle at the top of the clocktower (the spindle on the west side of the column).

route.title: Finishing off
steps: Head back down and talk to Brother Kojo for your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: The Equipment Room
steps: Speak to Denulth in the Burthorpe camp. Dialogue: "Do you have any quests for me?", "No, but perhaps I could try and find one?"
Ask Eohric on the of the castle about the guard that was on duty last night. Dialogue: "I'm looking for the guard that was on last night."
Speak to Harold upstairs in the bar in Burthorpe. Dialogue: "You're the guard that was on duty last night?"
Speak to Eohric again.
Go back to Harold.
Give him an Asgarnian ale.
Bet with Harold, you must bet over 60 gold (101 to immediately bankrupt him). Dialogue: "Would you like to gamble?"
Gamble until he gives you an "IOU". Read it to receive the combination.

Go to the castle and place the 5 coloured balls as shown in the image. The door will unlock (you have to read the note for this to work). Keep the note as you will need it to finish the quest, though if lost it can be reclaimed from Harold for free.

route.title: The Secret Path
steps: Go north-west of Burthorpe, enter the cave.
Ask Saba about another way up Death Plateau. Dialogue: "Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?"
Leave the cave, continue north-west then go south at the fork.
Talk to Tenzing. Dialogue: "OK, I'll get those for you."
Talk to Dunstan by the anvil in north-east Burthorpe.
Talk to Denulth where you started the quest, who will give you a certificate.

Talk to Dunstan to exchange your climbing boots, certificate and iron bar for spiked boots. (If you already own a pair of spiked boots, Dunstan will take the certificate, and then continue to the next step)
Return to Tenzing; give him 10 bread, 10 trout and the spiked boots to get the map. The bread and trout must be un-noted, and the items must be given all in one go.

Exit Tenzing's house through the north door and then climb over the stile. Take the path north and around to the east (past the second mountain goat) until the message "I think this is far enough" appears in the chat box (NOT the Death Plateau warning, this is another message; you can ignore the warning, since the trolls only attack you on the main path).
Talk to Denulth (make sure you have the combination with you when you do).
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Kangai Mau in the Brimhaven food store. Dialogue: "I'm in search of adventure!", "Ok, I will get it back."
Travel to Ardougne (you can take a ship from Brimhaven to complete an easy Karamja Diary task), and head to the GPDT depot just south of the eastern bank.
Investigate the most north-eastern crate for the address label.
Use the label on the crate located 2 tiles to the south of the first crate.
Talk to a GPDT employee. Dialogue: "So, when are you going to deliver this crate?"

Talk to Wizard Cromperty in the house north-east of the Ardougne market with the checkered floor. Dialogue: "So what have you invented?", "Can I be teleported please?", "Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!", or Dialogue: if you have completed the medium or higher Ardougne diaries.
Go west 2 doors and enter the password KURT. If you click too quickly it will say "This combination is incorrect", try again slower.
Right-click Investigate the stairs, requiring 21 Thieving, then climb them.
Search the chest on the top floor for the totem. You must finish the dialogue.
Return to Kangai Mau.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting Started
steps: In Seers' Village, go to the house immediately south of the anvil.
Search the bookcase on the eastern wall to find a battered book.
Read the book, then use a knife on it to get a Battered key.
Go to the building with anvil and open the Odd looking wall in the north (with the key in inventory).
Go down the stairs.

route.title: Repairing the Workshop
steps: Go into the room to the north.
Turn the water controls east of the water wheel.
Turn the water controls west of the water wheel.
Pull the lever by the water wheel.

(Optional) Kill one of each of the Elemental to complete Kandarin Easy Task. For the Earth Elemental, you must defeat one of the actual Elementals walking around; the rock that turns into the Elemental won't count towards the requirement.
(Optional) To obtain leather, search a crate north of the staircase in the middle room.
(Optional) To obtain a needle, search the two stacked crates on the left as you enter the west room.
Go to the eastern room.
With a needle, thread, and leather, fix the bellows.
Pull the lever by the bellows.
Go to the middle room and search the boxes in the north-east to get a stone bowl.
Go to the south room.
Use a stone bowl on the lava trough to the south.
Use the bowl of lava on the Furnace in the room.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Go to the western room and mine an elemental rock.
Kill the Earth elemental and pick up the elemental ore it drops (get 2 more ores if you are planning to do Elemental Workshop II).
Use the elemental ore and four coal on the furnace in the southern room. You will get an Elemental metal.
With the slashed book, go to the middle room and smith an elemental shield by using the elemental metal on the workbench.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Fletching some arrows
steps: Note: You must make the arrows yourself to progress.
Chop down at least 3 achey trees immediately south-west of Rantz.
Use a knife on the logs to make ogre arrow shafts.
Use 100 feathers on the ogre arrow shafts.
Obtain 4 wolf bones (south-west from Rantz).
Use a chisel on the bones.
Use the wolfbone arrowtips on the flighted ogre arrows.
Use the ogre arrows on Rantz.

route.title: Bloated toads
steps: Ask Rantz all possible questions. Dialogue: "How do we make the chompies come?", "What are 'fatsy toadies'?", "Where do we put the fatsy toadies?", "What do you mean 'sneaky..sneaky, stick da chompy?'", "Ok, thanks."
Enter the cave north of Rantz.
Attempt to unlock the chest until it opens and search it to obtain ogre bellows.
At the nearby swamp (south-west), look for swamp bubbles and click on them to fill up the ogre bellow.
Use the ogre bellows on a swamp toad to obtain a "bloated toad".

route.title: Hunting
steps: Talk to Rantz.
Drop a bloated toad where the arrow points.
Talk to Rantz again and wait for the chompy bird to appear.
After Rantz fires his bow, talk to him to receive an ogre bow. Dialogue: "Come on, let me have a go...", "I'm actually quite strong...please let me try."
If you are fast enough, you can attempt to kill the chompy bird that Rantz tried to hunt. Otherwise, place another toad in the clearing.
Pluck the carcass and take the raw chompy.
Talk to Rantz.

route.title: Cooking the bird
steps: Go back into the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs.
Obtain the ingredients that they've asked for. The image on this page shows their location.
Use the raw chompy on the spit-roast north of Rantz (the fire outside of the cave).
Talk to Rantz.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Sandy Hand
steps: Talk to Bert in Yanille, in the house next to the POH Portal to get a Sandy hand. Dialogue: "Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?", "Yes."
Go to the Dragon Inn pub south of Bert's house. Buy a beer from the bartender (if you don't have one) and give the beer to the Guard Captain.

Ring the bell at the Wizards' Guild (outside near eastern doors), or enter the guild with 66 Magic, then talk to Zavistic Rarve, who will take the Hand. If started Zogre Flesh Eaters: Dialogue: "I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you."

Talk to Zavistic Rarve again. He will offer to teleport you to Port Sarim. Dialogue: "Can you help me more?", "Yes, that would be great!" (Dialogue: if started Zogre Flesh Eaters)
Talk to Betty in Port Sarim Magic shop for a bottled water. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."
First add redberries, then white berries to the bottled water in order to get a pink dye.
Dye the lantern lens to get a rose-tinted lens.
Talk to Betty again so she puts the vial on the counter. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."
Go stand in the doorway and "use" the lens on the counter to get a truth serum.
Talk to Betty one last time with sand in your inventory. Dialogue: "Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand."

Return to Yanille, ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve.

steps: Speak to Tomas Lawry outside the Port Piscarilius bank.Dialogue: "I'm looking for a quest.", "Absolutely.", "Yes." (Grab a bowl from the general store on your way to the bank if you plan on making the stew yourself.)

Enter the manhole to the east marked by the File:Dungeon map link icon.png icon, cross the bridge a bit to the south, continue west.

Optional: Trade the General Store Shop Keeper in The Warrens for an easy Kourend & Kebos Diary task.

Exit the sewers and travel south-west to Kingstown and enter the house immediately north from the entrance (south of the File:Rare trees icon.png icon), and climb the stairs to the .
Picklock the chest in the east side of the room to find a letter. (You may have to click the lock multiple times)
Return to Tomas Lawry. Dialogue: "Let's talk about my quest."
Return to The Queen of Thieves (now called Lady Shauna Piscarilius).
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting the quest
steps: Travel to the Ruins of Uzer via the necklace of passage teleport to Eagle's Eyrie and run south-east. You can alternatively use a fairy ring () and go north-east.
Pick up and read the Letter west of the broken clay golem
Talk to the golem. Dialogue: "Shall I try to repair you?"
Use four soft clay on the golem. If you chose to bring a pickaxe and a bracelet of clay, clay rocks can be found to the north-west, near the shore. The phoenix can be found there as well.
Talk to the golem again. Dialogue: "How do I open the portal?"

route.title: The statuette
steps: Pick a black mushroom near the stairs east of the golem before heading down (or downstairs at your right).
Climb down the stairs in the ruins.
Take the strange implement from the north-western room.
Speak to the Golem again Dialogue: "How do I open the portal?"

Head to the most north-eastern part of the Digsite, near the large buried skeleton, and talk to Elissa. Dialogue: "I found a letter in the desert with your name on." (make sure to read the letter if no 3rd option is seen)
Head to the Exam Centre just south of the Digsite.
Search the bookcase in the south-east corner and read Varmen's notes.

Talk to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about the statuette. Dialogue: "I'm looking for a statuette recovered from the city of Uzer.", "I want to open a portal to the lair of an elder-demon." (Dialogue: if Bone Voyage is started)
Pickpocket him for the display cabinet key.
Head upstairs, and open the second-most western case in the northern-most row. You will get a statuette.

route.title: The portal
steps: Return to the Kharidian Desert (fairy ring ), or teleport to Eagle's Eyrie with Necklace of passage.
Return to the ruins of Uzer where you started the quest and again go down the stairs.
In the centre of the room will be four alcoves. Place the statuette in the empty one.
Turn the statues until they all point north.
Go north, through the double doors.
Optional: Use your chisel and hammer on the throne for 2 sapphires, emeralds, and rubies.
Otherwise, immediately go back through the south portal.

route.title: The golem
steps: Go back upstairs and talk to the golem.
With an empty vial in your inventory, grind the black mushroom using a Pestle and mortar.
Use the phoenix feather on the black dye to make a phoenix quill pen.
Talk to the golem
Use the phoenix quill pen on a piece of papyrus to get the golem program.
Use the strange implement on the golem then quickly use the newly acquired golem program on the golem.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting started
steps: Begin the quest by talking to Irena, located just south of Shantay Pass (fairy ring , then run north-east). Dialogue: "What's the matter?"

route.title: Getting into the camp
steps: Go to the Desert Mining Camp entrance (south of Irena).

Talk to the Mercenary Captain. Dialogue: "Wow! A real captain!", "I'd love to work for a tough guy like you!", "Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you?", "Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that.", "It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!"
He will attack you. Kill him and get the key of the gate. (All damage can be dealt via recoil)
Unequip any weapons AND armour and enter the gate.

route.title: Getting into the mine
steps: Talk to the Male slave on the east wall (not the south-east wall) when no guard is nearby. Dialogue: "I've just arrived.", "Oh yes, that sounds interesting.", "What's that then?", "I can try to undo them for you.", "It's funny you should say that...", "Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.", "Yes, I'll trade." If a guard sees you, you are jailed: bend the window bars, climb out, climb the rock wall and cliff, and enter through the gate again.
Equip the slave's clothes
Enter the mine to the north
Follow the path until you reach a guarded cave entrance.
Talk to one of the guards until he mentions a Tenti pineapple. Dialogue: "I'd like to mine in a different area.", "Yes sir, you're quite right sir.", "Yes sir, we understand each other perfectly."
Run back to the surface, unequip ALL pieces of your slave robes and leave the desert camp through the front gate, or return to fairy ring .

route.title: The plans
steps: Talk to Al Shabim in the south tent in the Bedabin Camp (directly west of the Desert Mining Camp). You will be given a Bedabin key. Dialogue: "I am looking for a pineapple.", "Yes, I'm interested."

Go back to the Desert Mining Camp. (Make sure to put on your slave outfit (and unequip anything else) before entering the gate. If you inadvertently dropped your slave outfit, you can get another one from a slave by repeating the earlier trade with the desert clothing.)
Go up the ladder in the jail building and search the southernmost bookcase on the western wall. A message should pop up stating "You notice several books on the subject of sailing."
In the same room, talk to Captain Siad. Dialogue: "I wanted to have a chat?", "You seem to have a lot of books!", "So, you're interested in sailing?", "I could tell by the cut of your jib."
Open the chest to obtain the technical plans. (Make sure you click continue, so the plans go to your inventory)
Go back to the Bedabin Camp and show Al Shabim the plans. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm very interested.", "Yes, I'm kind of curious."
Use the anvil in the northern tent. Following the plans, create a prototype dart.
Take the dart to Al Shabim, who will in return give you the Tenti pineapple.

route.title: Finding Ana
steps: Equip your Slave outfit and head back to the guards in the mine with your pineapple and give it to one of them.
Go through the cave entrance and head east until you're beside the mine cart.
Right-click search the nearby barrels to get a barrel. Dialogue: "Yeah, cool!"
Get into the mine cart by right-click searching it. Dialogue: "Yes, of course." (If you fail to start the cutscene redo this step)
Take the west-north-west path and use a barrel on Ana (blonde hair at the end of the second north-western path).

route.title: Saving Ana
steps: Head back to the mine cart. Put Ana in the mine cart, then take the cart yourself. Dialogue: "Yes, of course."
Search nearby barrels to find Ana.
Put Ana on the winch bucket (north-west area of room).
Don't raise the guard's suspicions when he offers help. Dialogue: "Yes please.", "I said you were very gregarious!"
Head back to the surface.
Operate the winch (south-west in the camp), then search the barrel west of the winch to find Ana. (Do not go through the gate)
Put Ana on the wooden cart at the centre of the Camp.

Talk to the mine cart driver. Dialogue: "Nice cart.", "One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'.", "'One good turn deserves another.'", "Fired... no, shot perhaps!", "In for a penny in for a pound.", "Well, you see, it's like this...", "Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!", "You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!"
Get on the cart by searching it. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll get on."
Head back to Irena for your reward.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Go to the house west of the The Cloak and Stagger tavern in Shayzien. (Xeric's Talisman - 1. Xeric's Lookout and run north-west, or Fairy Ring )
Speak to Phileas Rimor, and agree to help him. Dialogue: "Do you need help with anything?", "Yes."
Gather a ranged weapon, a melee weapon (a pickaxe counts as a valid melee weapon), and runes to perform any magic attack if you have not already.
Go to the Arceuus Library (Fairy ring or Lovakengj Minecart Network) and speak to Archeio to teleport to the Library Historical Archive.
Speak to Pagida, and agree to be teleported into the Tower of Magic prison. Dialogue: "I have a question about King Shayzien VII.", "Yes please."
Push the strange device all the way west. From the north side, attack the device using magic.
From the south side, attack using melee. (Note: Make sure your NPC attack options are not set to hidden, or the Attack option will not appear!)
Push the strange device all the way east. From the south side, attack using ranged.
Investigate the skeleton in the northern cell.
Return to the quest start and talk to Phileas Rimor (Xeric's Talisman - 1. Xeric's Lookout and run north-west).
Go north-west to the War Tent in the south-west corner of the Shayzien Encampment. Go upstairs and speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien.
Travel to the summit of Mount Quidamortem. (Lovakengj Minecart Network or Xeric's Talisman - 5. Xeric's Honour if it is unlocked) or Fairy ring (if unlocked)
Speak to Historian Duffy. (near the water symbol on the minimap)
Use a rope on the crevice on the western side of the mountain, and enter the crevice. Go around to the south, not through the middle. (near the ! symbol on minimap)
Mine the Boulder.
Push the Boulder.
Attempt to pass the magic gate, and kill the Corrupt Lizardman.
Pass through the magic gate and inspect the Unstable Altar.
Hop worlds after you finish the dialogue to quickly leave the cave.
Speak to Historian Duffy again.
Go back to the unstable altar in the cave.
Speak to Duffy and then Gnosi near the unstable altar. Make sure to speak to them BOTH.
Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien back at the war tent (Fairy ring , Lovakengj Minecart Network, or Speak to the Mountain Guide).
Return to Phileas's house and walk inside to get dialogue. He will not be there.
Return to Lord Shiro Shayzien once more.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Sigmund on the of the Lumbridge Castle. Dialogue: "Do you have any quests for me?", "Yes"
Ask the following people about what happened in the cellar. You can stop when one mentions a goblin in the basement.
Talk to Duke Horacio again. Dialogue: "The cook says he saw something in the cellar" (Dialogue: "The cook says he saw something in the cellar" if started Dragon Slayer)
Climb-down the trapdoor in the kitchen on the .
Use your pickaxe on the rubble in the basement and climb through the hole.
Light your light source and grab the brooch which sits on the floor about 10 steps into cave.
Show the brooch to the duke. Dialogue: "Talk about something else.", "I dug through the rubble..." or Dialogue: "I dug through the rubble..." or Dialogue: "I dug through the rubble..."
Go to the Varrock Palace library in Varrock.
Talk to Reldo. Dialogue: "..." or Dialogue: if not started shield of Arrav
Search the northern bookcase on the west wall for goblin symbol book.
Read through the book.

Go to Goblin Village and talk to the generals, and mediate for them until you learn goblin emotes. Dialogue: "Have you ever heard of the Dorgeshuun?", "It doesn't really matter", "Well either way they refused to fight", "Well I found a brooch underground...", "Well why not show me both greetings?"
Go back to the Lumbridge Castle cellar and follow the map in the image on this page through the caves. Don't stray from it! (Clicking on the minimap also auto-paths the correct path)
At the end of the cave talk to Mistag, and do your Goblin Bow in front of him.
Talk to Mistag then let him take you back to Lumbridge. Dialogue: "Can you show me the way out of the mines?"
Talk to the duke. He won't believe you. Dialogue: "I've made contact with the cave goblins..." or Dialogue: "I've made contact with the cave goblins..."
Pickpocket Sigmund and unlock his chest in the other room to find some HAM robes. Keep them for Death to the Dorgeshuun.
Go to the HAM lair west of Lumbridge Castle.
Pick the lock on the trapdoor and enter the lair.
Search the crate south of the ladder to find the stolen silverware.
Bring the silverware to the Duke. He will fire Sigmund and give you a signed peace treaty. Dialogue: "I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!"
Go into the basement again. Follow Kazgar to travel to Mistag. Dialogue:
Talk to Mistag, with the peace treaty in your inventory, and a cutscene will play.

route.title: Starting out
steps: Head to the entrance of the mountain camp east of Rellekka or north of the fairy ring.
Take the path north, past the guard, and use your rope on a boulder you can push to get around.

Head into the camp and talk to Hamal the Chieftain. Dialogue: "Why is everyone so hostile?", "So what are you doing up here?", "I will search for her!" (or Dialogue: "Why is everyone so hostile?", "So what are you doing up here?", "I will search for her!" with The Fremennik Trials completed)

route.title: Crisis
steps: Dig some mud from the mud pond south of Hamal's house.
Go north, following the path along the lake westward.
Use the mud on the tall tree then climb it. You do *not* need to do this again for subsequent climbs.
Use your pole or staff on the clump of rocks to pole vault over.
Use your plank on the flat stones. Keep this throughout the quest.
Listen to the shining pool. Dialogue: "Hello! Who are you?", "So what exactly do you want from me?", "That sounds like something I can do.", "I'll get right on it."
Use your plank on the flat stone to return to shore.

route.title: Making Peace
steps: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain about the people of Rellekka. Dialogue: "About the people of Rellekka...", "Why do you hate them so much?"
Speak to Jokul north of the Cheiftains tent before leaving the camp to speak to Svidi.
Search for Svidi between Rellekka and the entrance to Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?"

Go to Rellekka and talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the mountain camp.", "Did it contain vast magical powers?" or Dialogue: "Ask about the mountain camp.", "Did it contain vast magical powers?" if Lunar Diplomacy started/completed.
Return to the Mountain Camp, and enter the large tent south-west of Hamal the Chieftain.
Use your pickaxe on the Ancient Rock located in the southern tent to get half a rock.

Take this back to Rellekka, and talk to Brundt the Chieftain Dialogue: "Ask about the mountain camp." or Dialogue: "Ask about the mountain camp." if Lunar Diplomacy started/completed, who will give you the guarantee of safe passage.
Take the guarantee to Svidi. You do not need to check on Svidi afterward.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain. Dialogue: "About the people of Rellekka..."

route.title: The White Pearl
steps: Talk to Hamal the Chieftan again, this time about food supplies. Dialogue: "About your food supplies...", "Never mind."
Talk to Jokul just north of Hamal. If you spoke to him earlier you do not need to do this. He will tell you of a White Pearl plant that is very hardy.
Travel to White Wolf Mountain (Gnome glider if The Grand Tree completed, or Keldagrim minecart system if The Giant Dwarf is completed.)
Equip gloves and pick-from the thorny bushes by the gnome glider.
Eat the white pearl you picked to get the white pearl seed.
Speak to Hamal the Chieftain to give him the white pearl seed. Dialogue: "About your food supplies..."

route.title: The Kendal
steps: Speak to the shining pool again (remember to use the pole/staff and plank).
Cross the gap back to shore
Follow the northern path east to a cave.
Chop down the trees blocking your path (make sure you are facing east)
Enter the cave

Talk to The Kendal. Dialogue: "It's just me, no one special.", "You mean a sacrifice?", "You look like a man in a bearsuit!", "Can I see that corpse?", "I humbly request to be given the remains.", "I will kill you myself!"
Kill The Kendal. He can be safespotted utilising skeletons around the room.
Take the corpse of woman
Return to Hamal the Chieftain. Dialogue: "But he's not a god!", "I will."
Gather 5 muddy rocks from around the camp.
Talk to Ragnar near the tall tree by the lake to get Asleif's necklace.
Return to the shining pool and bury the corpse on the island.
Use the muddy rocks on the burial mound. (You make the mound by burying the corpse on the island.)
Congratulations, quest complete!

Speak to Gordon.

Speak to Gordon one more time.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village. Dialogue: "What do you need assistance with?", "So how would I go about catching them then?", "Ok, I will do it then" ()

Go to Seers Village and speak to a Seer. (Wait until the seer is done checking himself in the mirror.) Dialogue: "Your friend Thormac sent me to speak to you." Be sure not to skip this step, as the scorpion in Taverley Dungeon is not accessible without first speaking to the seer.
Scorpions can be caught in any order and there is no need to return between each catch.

route.title: First scorpion
steps: Note: You will need a dusty key if you don't have 70 Agility, make sure to grab it before entering the dungeon.
Go into Taverley Dungeon, (South Taverley) and go to the poison spider area.
Directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut, search the old wall to enter a small room.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Second scorpion
steps: Go to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace is helpful).
Go inside the fenced in area near the entrance to the agility course.
Go inside the building in the north-east corner of the area.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Third scorpion
steps: Go to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet will take you right there).
Climb the eastern ladder and go to the east side of the floor.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Finishing Up
steps: Return the full scorpion cage to Thormac.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to the Wanderer north-east of Sophanem (see picture) and ask why she has a problem with your cat. Dialogue: "Why? What's your problem with it?", "Ok I'll get your supplies."
Talk to the Wanderer again to give her a tinderbox and waterskin(4). Dialogue: "Yes. I have them all here."
Touch the door of the pyramid where you wake up.

route.title: The first flashback
steps: Navigate by clicking the minimap to automatically avoid the traps.
Jump the pit (20% minimum energy required, higher Agility increases your chances).
Go west and open the door.
Click on the large golden bird to reset the puzzle until it lands on the solution shown in the image on this page. Then click the tiles indicated on the picture.

route.title: The sphinx
steps: Drop your cat and talk to the Sphinx, ask for help. Dialogue: "I need help.", "Okay, that sounds fair."
Riddle answer: 9. Dialogue: ".", "Totally positive."(if you give the wrong answer your cat will disappear)
Talk to the High Priest to the south-west.

route.title: The second flashback
steps: Return to the pyramid (right-click door and open) and jump the pit again to trigger the next flashback.
Open the western door (directly south of you) and take the canopic jar back (you can only pick up the correct one).
A level 75 or 81 enemy (see the guardians in the info box above) will appear, kill it and take the jar.
Leave the room and jump across the pit.
Jump back across the pit.
Solve the western door puzzle and drop the jar where you found it.
Leave the room again and jump across the pit once more.
Exit the pyramid via the entrance ladder.

route.title: Preparing for the ceremony
steps: Talk to the High Priest. Dialogue: "Sure, no problem."
Go to the house south of the church and talk to the Embalmer to give him the linen, salt, and sap.
Go east and talk to the Carpenter. He will take your willow logs and give you a holy symbol.

route.title: The third flashback
steps: Enter the pyramid (right click, open door).
Jump the gap again to trigger the 3rd flashback.
Enter the east door and use the holy/unholy symbol on any sarcophagus. Exit the room.
Jump back across the pit and enter the eastern room again.
Kill the level 91 Possessed Priest.
Talk to the High Priest.

route.title: The fourth flashback
steps: Exit the pyramid.
Talk to the High Priest in the temple.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Speak to the Dwarven Boatman. ( then go through the tunnel to the south west. Once inside proceed through the Cave Entrance directly ahead between the two statues. ) Dialogue: "That's a deal!", "Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes."
Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban. Dialogue: "Yes, I will do this."
Talk to Blasidar the sculptor on the east side of Keldagrim, south of the kebab shop. Dialogue: "Yes, I will do this."

route.title: Fit for a King
steps: Talk to Vermundi, the silk trader in the eastern market. (Big building east side of river, silk icon) Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes."
Talk to the Librarian in the library, located at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?"
Climb any bookcase to find a book on costumes known as the 'Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes'.
If you didn't bring coal, mine in the north-east corner of East Keldagrim or purchase from Ordan in the Blast Furnace.
Talk to Vermundi again. Dialogue: "Yes, about those special clothes again..."
Use your coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi then light it with a tinderbox.
Talk to Vermundi again and pay 200gp for exquisite clothes. Dialogue: "Yes, about those special clothes again...", "I'll pay."
If you didn't bring the 3 Sapphires, they can be purchased from Hervi at the Gem stall just to the north of Vermundi.
While here, steal from the baker's or crafting stall for completion of a task in the Easy Fremennik Diary (optional)
Talk to Saro at the anvil south-west of the bank in West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots."
Speak to Dromund in the house just north of the bank.
Take the left boot when he isn't looking.
Go outside behind his house and telegrab the right boot through the window when he isn't looking.

Talk to Santiri at the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.", "Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.", "Perhaps I can repair the axe?"
Use your 3 sapphires on the axe (now in your inventory) and talk to him again. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe."
If you have not completed The Knight's Sword Quest then you must speak to the librarian and then to Reldo in Varrock Library.

Talk to Thurgo at Mudskipper Point (), and give him an iron bar to repair the axe. Dialogue: "Something else.", "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Return to Keldagrim immediately." (Dialogue: "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Would you like a redberry pie?", "Can you help me with this ancient axe?", "Return to Keldagrim immediately." May need a redberry pie if Thurgo has not received one recently).
You will be given the option to immediately return to Keldagrim; do so. Dialogue: "Return to Keldagrim immediately."

route.title: Halfway there
steps: Once in Blasidar's house, talk to Riki the sculptor's model to give him the clothes, axe and boots.
Talk to Blasidar. Watch the cutscene.

route.title: Joining the consortium
steps: Go to the upper floor of the market and talk to the secretary of any company except the Red Axe. Dialogue: "Is there anything I can help you with?". Ensure you perform tasks only for the company you choose, as the progress for each is separate. Buy the ores from Ordan in the Blast Furnace to save time.
Offer to help them. The secretaries require you to retrieve ores (cannot be noted). Be sure to read the dialogue to know what ores you need or fill your inventory with about 5 of each.

A hidden scoring system determines your progress with a company; each ore delivery completed gives 20 points, while failing or refusing a task subtracts 2 points. Once you reach 75 points, you can deliver metal bars for the director for 12 points each; 100 points is required to progress through this section.
Talk to the director after making enough progress and complete a few tasks for them. Dialogue: "Do you have any more tasks for me?"

After enough tasks, the director asks whether you've considered joining their company or states that you don't need to be doing running errands for them anymore. Join the company. Dialogue: "I'd like to officially join your company."
Tell the director that Blasidar sent you, offer your support. Dialogue: "Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.", "I would support you.", "Yes! Long live the <company name>!"
Go back and talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank, he will ask if you want to attend the meeting. You may choose not to.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Speak to Denulth directly South of the Burthorpe Teleport. Dialogue: "How goes your fight with the trolls?", "Is there anything I can do to help?", "I'll get Godric back!"

Follow the path to the stronghold. You can buy the climbing boots along the way from Tenzing. (Note: If you have completed The Easy Combat Achievements you can skip this section, including the fight with Dad, by teleporting with Ghommal's hilt 1)
Enter the arena and attempt to kill Dad. The fight will end before Dad is killed (can be safespotted from the gate; magic or a halberd are good choices due to his high range defence).
After nearly killing Dad exit the arena through the north gate.
Go through the cave and continue the path to the stronghold; Thrower trolls can be dealt with by:
Enter the stronghold through the cave entrance.

route.title: Stronghold Dungeon
steps: Follow the red path to Troll General. Kill one and loot the prison key. (Can be safespotted with a halberd, magic, or a ranged weapon behind the counter) (Hardcore Ironmen beware! The general is aggressive and his max hit is 38)
Follow the green path to jail.
Pickpocket (30+ ) or kill the sleeping Twig and Berry (this can be safespotted through the open cell doors either side of them), free both of the prisoners.
Teleport to Burthorpe with the games necklace OR follow them out the secret exit and once outside climb over the south-east rocks.
Talk to Dunstan.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak in level 4-7 Wilderness near the river (Cannot be wearing a non-Zamorak God item).

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to Sanfew (top floor of the Taverley herblore store) Dialogue: "Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?", "I'll do it.", or Dialogue: "Ask general questions.", "Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?", "I'll do it." if you have completed Zogre Flesh Eaters).
Climb to the top of Trollheim, using the agility shortcuts if you can to save time, and enter Eadgar's Cave (see map for path alternatives).

If you have not yet freed Eadgar in the troll stronghold's prison, pickpocket (30+ ) or kill Berry the northern sleeping troll guard and use the cell key 2 on Eadgar's cell. Check your Troll Stronghold quest log and there will be a line that will either say "I've rescued Godric" or "I've rescued Godric and Mad Eadgar" to make sure.
Speak with Eadgar in his cave. Dialogue: "I need to find some goutweed."
Go to Burntmeat's Kitchen, which is at the south end of the middle floor of the stronghold.
Talk to Burntmeat.

Return to Eadgar and speak with him.}}Secret Door through Rellekka Route{{Checklist|*For the secret door path, Slayer ring teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or use the Fairy ring with (code ) to teleport outside the Dungeon entrance.
Head north-east to a narrow passage, climb over the rocks, and go through the secret entrance to the north.
Head to Burntmeat's Kitchen, which is at the south end of the middle floor of the stronghold.
Talk to Burntmeat.
Go speak with Eadgar, whose cave is at the top of Trollheim.

route.title: The parrot
steps: Use vodka (right click it to avoid accidentally drinking it) on the pineapple chunks.
Use alco-chunks on the aviary hatch (west side of parrot cage).
Do not drop the parrot or it will fly away and you will need to retrieve it from Eadgar.
Talk to Eadgar in his cave at Trollheim about making the fake human.
Go back to the Troll Stronghold. You may skip this and use the parrot on your way back to Eadgar in the next section if using the agility way.
Run north and go down both flights of stairs.
Use the parrot on the rack north of the cells.

route.title: Making the "human"
steps: Talk to Tegid in Taverley south-east of the Herblore store for a dirty robe. Dialogue: "Sanfew won't be happy..."

Pick a thistle in one of the grass patches near Eadgar's cave entrance. It is very small and coloured the same as the grass. Zoom in close on each patch to find a green flower around the patch of grass. It can be hard to see. Note that it only spawns in one of the patches of grass at a time.
Enter Eadgar's cave and talk to Eadgar.
Light a fire with your other log and cook the thistle on it to make a dried thistle. (You may also use one of the fires near the trolls to the west.)
Use the pestle and mortar on the dried thistle and add it to a ranarr potion (unf).
Talk to Eadgar.
Retrieve your parrot from the rack in the troll stronghold.
Talk to Eadgar.
Give the fake man to Burntmeat.
Search the kitchen drawers by the south wall to obtain a storeroom key.

route.title: Getting the goutweed
steps: Go down the nearby stairs inside the kitchen to the storeroom.
Sneak to the back and take goutweed. Note:
Return the goutweed to Sanfew. Dialogue:
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to Charlie in Ardougne Zoo. Dialogue: "Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!", "Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?"

route.title: Eagles' Peak
steps: Head to Eagles' Peak west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Go to the northern side of the mountain's base to a campsite (by the agility shortcut on the world map).
Inspect the books to receive a Bird book.
Click on the book to obtain a Metal feather.
Climb the rocks attached to the mountain next to the campsite, or follow the grey path south-east of the campsite if you don't have 25 Agility.
Use the metal feather on the Rocky outcrop and enter the cave.
In the dungeon, go east to the Y-shaped intersection, then head south to the edge of the canyon.

Try to take one of the giant feathers from the south-western most pile to receive eagle feathers, and Nickolaus will shout at you. Dialogue: "The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.", "Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you.", "Could I help at all?"
Pick up 10 eagle feathers from any pile on the ground.

route.title: The disguise
steps: Head to the south-east corner of Varrock to the Fancy Clothes Store (via Varrock tele, Rat Pits Grouping teleport, etc.)
Talk to Asyff. Dialogue: "Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes."
Talk to Asyff again. Dialogue: "I've got the feathers and materials you requested.", "Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up."

route.title: =Bronze feather=
steps: Go back into the Eagles' Peak Dungeon.
Enter the farthest south-west tunnel in the dungeon.
Try to grab the feather from the pedestal.
Operate the four winches in the corners of the room in any order.
Grab the Bronze feather.

route.title: =Silver feather=
steps: Exit the tunnel and enter the next tunnel to the north.
Inspect the pedestal and complete the trail by inspecting the first rock to the east, then the rocks to the north-east. (27 Hunter Required)
Inspect the opening in the wall north-east of the cave and threaten the kebbit. Select taunt. Dialogue: "Taunt the kebbit."
Pick up the Silver feather.

route.title: =Golden feather=
steps: Exit the tunnel back to the main dungeon and run up the farthest north-east path.
Go through the tunnel entrance.

route.title: ==The puzzle==
steps: Take 6 handfuls of bird seed near the entrance.
Pull the lever marked (1).
Place bird seed in (2).
Place bird seed in (3).
Pull lever (4).
Push lever (5) (the same one as 1).
Place bird seed in (6).
Pull lever (7).
Place bird seed in (8).
Pull lever (9).
Place bird seed in (10).
Place bird seed in (11) (the same feeder as 6).
Retrieve the golden feather from the pedestal to the west.

route.title: The eagle door
steps: Exit the golden feather tunnel and go to the door south of Nickolaus.
Use all 3 feathers (bronze, silver, gold) on the door's eagle carving and enter it (the metal feather only opens the dungeon).
Equip the Eagle cape and Fake beak you made for yourself earlier.
While wearing the disguise, click the Giant eagle and 'walk-past the Giant eagle' and talk to Nickolaus.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Exit the eagles' dungeon and go back to the campsite north of the mountain.
Talk to Nickolaus. Dialogue: "Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.", "That sounds good to me."
Once the cutscene is over, you will have a ferret in your inventory. (Do not release it or you will have to catch another.)
Go back to the Ardougne Zoo and talk to Charlie.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Beginning the quest
steps: Pray at the Ectofuntus 7 or more times and talk to the Ghost disciple to get enough ecto-tokens for the quest.
Talk to Velorina inside Port Phasmatys in the house just east of the gates to begin the quest. Dialogue: "Why, what is the matter?", "Yes, I do. It is a very sad story.", "Yes."
Talk to Necrovarus back at the Ectofuntus.
Talk to Velorina again. Dialogue: "Do you know where this woman can be found?"

route.title: The old crone and some nettle tea
steps: A few steps east of Slayer master Mazchna in Canifis is a patch of nettles. Wear your gloves and pick at least five: the nettle water can easily boil over, especially at low cooking levels.
Combine the nettle with the bowl of water, and cook it over a fire (there is a dead tree just south-east of the slayer tower). Do not drink the tea.
Head north-west to the old crone's house by the water, just east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to the old crone east next to the slayer tower with nettle tea in your inventory. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus."

Put the tea in the porcelain cup and add your bucket of milk to the tea, then talk to the old crone again. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus.", "You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?"

route.title: =The book of Haricanto=
steps: Repair the model ship by using the needle on it. This will use up the silk and a thread.
Head to the wrecked ship on the coast north-west of the Ectofuntus and directly north of the farming allotment.
Climb up a ladder to the ship deck. Then, climb another ladder to get to the ship quarterdeck.
Wait for the wind speed to drop to low, and search the mast multiple times to find out what colour the three components of the flag are.
Dye the model ship's flag the right colours, mixing dyes as needed (use the dye on the toy ship and select which part to dye).
Head down one level to the ship deck, talk to the Old man. Dialogue: "Is this your toy boat?"
Use the key on the closed chest inside the captain's quarters to receive the first map scrap.

Climb down to the lowest level of the ship and get ready to fight. Search the chests until you are attacked by a giant lobster (level 32). Kill it, then search the chest it came out of to get the second map scrap.
Climb back up the ladder and proceed to the north-west side of deck where there is a gangplank you can walk out onto some rocks.
Jump along the path of rocks. At the end, there will be another chest with the final map scrap. (Save some run energy as some rocks take 5% energy)
Fit all the map pieces together to get a completed treasure map.
Head back inside Port Phasmatys again, and go south-east onto the docks. Take the small rowing boat to Dragontooth Island which is south-east at the docks.
Once there, use the map to find the treasure starting at the statue (or use the image on the right to find it). Dig with your spade, and you will find the book of Haricanto.

route.title: =The translation manual=
steps: Return to Port Phasmatys.
Talk to Ak-Haranu around the docks. Dialogue: "Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow."
Talk to Robin in the inn. He'll challenge you to a game of Rune-Draw. Beat him four times (in total, does not need to be consecutive) so he owes you 100 coins.
He'll give you the signed oak bow to repay the debt.
Take it back to Ak-Haranu for the translation manual.

route.title: =The robes=
steps: Ask the ghost innkeeper if he has any jobs for you. He'll give you a bedsheet. Dialogue: "Do you have any job I can do?", "Yes, I'd be delighted."
Use bucket of slime on the bedsheet to dye it (can be bought from trader crewmembers at the docks to the east) and Wear it.
Talk to Gravingas, the ghost activist protesting just inside the town's gate. He'll ask you for 10 signatures. Dialogue: "After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out."

Ask ghost villagers around town for signatures with the bedsheet equipped. You can alternate between just two ghosts for all the signatures. If one asks you for ecto-tokens, you can ignore them and ask the other, or you can pay if you have tokens to spare.
With all 10 signatures, show the petition to Necrovarus.
Take the key Necrovarus drops and head upstairs. Use the key on the door and enter the room. Take his robes from the coffin.

route.title: Using the spell
steps: Return to the old crone. Dialogue: "I'm here about Necrovarus."

Head back to the ectofuntus and talk to Necrovarus. Dialogue: "Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world." Once you've spoken to Necrovarus, you will be able to enter Port Phasmatys freely.
Enter Port Phasmatys one last time and talk to Velorina.
Congratulations, quest complete!

Go to the Wintertodt camp (Games necklace teleport).
Talk to the dwarf Undor inside the camp. Dialogue: "I've been sent to help you."

route.title: =Powergrid=
steps: Go to The Forsaken Tower to the east of Mount Karuulm, west of Lovakengj (north-east of fairy ring , Battlefront Teleport or Skills necklace to Farming Guild).
Inspect the Display Case.
Go down the ladder behind the Display Case and open the north-eastern door.
Search the north-north-east crate for a generator crank.
Inspect the steam generator in the south. Dialogue: "Start the generator."
Inspect the Power Grid. Dialogue: "Yes."

route.title: =Furnace=
steps: Go up the ladder and then into the northern room. Search the cupboards for a tinderbox, 5-gallon jug, and 8-gallon jug.
If doing the diary task, smelt the adamantite bar now.

route.title: =Potion=
steps: Go upstairs.
Open the door, then take the notes from the eastern cupboard.

Take the cleansing fluid from the northern table. The position will be random for everyone. Look at the notes to see the riddle: the fluids are listed in order of 1-2-3-4-5 (e.g. if cleansing fluid is the second potion mentioned in the fourth sentence, it is number 5).
Use the cleansing fluid on the refinery to the south, then activate it Dialogue: "Yes.", "Yes."

steps: Go up the ladder.
There are four discs. In the following order, remove a disc from a pylon and place it on another pylon:
Go downstairs and get Dinh's hammer from the display case.

steps: Return to Wintertodt Camp.
Use the hammer on Undor.
Return to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to the guard out front of Sinclair Mansion and agree to help. Dialogue: "Sure, I'll help."
Go north-west and investigate the sacks in the shed, take 4 flypapers.
Go inside the mansion and take the pungent pot and criminal's dagger.
Investigate the smashed window on the eastern side for the criminal's thread.
Search the barrels in the bedroom owned by the following two suspects to get 2 silver items.
Go to the kitchen and fill your pot with flour from the barrel.
Use flour and flypaper to dust each silver item and the dagger.
Use the silver items' prints on the dagger's print until you get a match. Remember who it is.

route.title: What is this? A workshop for giants?
steps: Minigame Teleport to "Giants' Foundry"
Speak to Kovac (strike the Hill Giant) in the Giants' Plateau. Dialogue: "Yes."
Once inside, repair the polishing wheel, grindstone, and trip hammer using the required items.
Speak to Kovac twice.
Search the crate for items.
Deposit all the items into the crucible (large bucket) hanging to the east by the bank. Different items are input separately.

route.title: Make-A-Sword
steps: Speak to Kovac to learn how to select the moulds (in red text).
Select the fitting mould Kovac described for the forte, blade and tip at the mould jig.
Speak to Kovac again. He will tell you to pour the metal.
Pour the metal from the crucible into the mould.

Get a bucket of water (grab a bucket from the pile of buckets and use it on the waterfall), and pour it on the sword. You can also use ice gloves for this step. Your hands must be free to pick up the preform.

Heat the preform to maximum by using it on the lava pool. The "Heat-preform" option will increase the heat by small increments, while the "Dunk-preform" option will heat it faster. The temperature should be red.

Hit the preform with the Trip Hammer repaired earlier, repeating until progress bar is onto the yellow section. Be sure to keep the temperature in the red while doing this, otherwise the quality of the sword will decrease. Using the Trip Hammer will cool the preform.
Cool the preform using the waterfall until its temperature is almost green. The "Cool-preform" option will cool the preform slowly, while the "Quench-preform" option cools is more quickly.
Use the preform on Grindstone repaired earlier, repeating until progress is onto green section. Be sure to watch the temperature as the Grindstone will heat the preform during use.
Cool the preform in the waterfall until its temperature is high green.
Use the preform on the Polishing Wheel, repeating until the sword is complete. The Polishing Wheel will cool the preform during use, so be sure to watch the temperature.
Speak to Kovac.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Follow Kazgar, who is through the hole in the wall under Lumbridge kitchen
Talk to Mistag at the Dorgeshuun mines to start the quest. Dialogue: "What is this favour?", "Yes."
Bring two sets of H.A.M. robes to Zanik in Lumbridge cellar. (Can be purchased from the G.E.) Dialogue: "Yes, I'm [player name]!", "Yes, I have two sets of robes!"
Zanik will follow you, if you lose her go back to the cellar. Talk to the townspeople with her following.
# Talk to the Cook
# Talk to the Duke
# Talk to Hans
# Talk to any Man or Woman (Zanik must engage in the conversation. Try another if she does not.)
# Talk to Bob
# Talk to Father Aereck
# Talk to Lumbridge Guide
# Walk near a goblin. Zanik will talk to one.
# Talk to the shopkeeper
Ask Zanik, "Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?" Dialogue: "Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?", "Yes"
Put on your set of H.A.M. robes, and go to the H.A.M. Hideout (west of the general store) and pick the lock to the entrance trapdoor.
Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht south-east of the stage. Dialogue: "Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?", "That's good."
Wander around the south of the stage, Zanik will spot a trapdoor.
Pick the trapdoor and go down. You'll need Zanik to kill the guards in this room to continue:
#Walk west past the first guard and talk to him, then Zanik will shoot him.

#Squeeze through the crack in the wall. Wait for the guard in the central corridor to walk by, then squeeze through the next crack in the wall. Run west behind the guard by the door and talk to him, then Zanik will shoot him.
#When the guard in the corridor starts walking east, talk to Zanik and say "Now!", and Zanik will snipe him.

#Move to the east side of the central corridor but stop with Zanik as far east as possible without joining the eastern corridor (this can be easily done by moving into that square and then walking one square west but be careful not to walk into the Eastern corridor). Talk to Zanik again and tell her to wait. Then, run west, south then east to the end of the corridor So the north eastern guard sees you and walks towards you. Zanik will shoot him as he passes the central corridor.

#For the final guard, again position Zanik as far north on as you can without the guard seeing you. Tell her to wait here and then head to the opposite position (top of the east/west corridors). Walk northward, causing the guard to walk towards you and Zanik will shoot him.
Listen at the door. A senior guard will appear and arrest you.
Pick the lock to escape the cell, then climb up the ladder and leave the hideout to find Zanik, dead. Take her body.
Go to Juna in the Chasm of Tears.
Talk to Juna and collect 20 Tears of Guthix to start the cutscene. Remember to have both hands free. Dialogue: "Yes."
With your full H.A.M. robes and gear for the fight, return to the castle cellar and talk to Zanik. Dialogue: "Let's go!"
Go to the chicken farm near the water wheel (File:Dairy churn icon.png icon on the east side of the river) and go through the southern gate.
With both hands free, search one of the southern empty crates and Zanik will hide in it. Dialogue: "I don't know, what are you thinking?", "Good idea."
While wearing the full H.A.M. robes, climb down the nearby trapdoor, and head to the western room. You will see Sigmund (level 50) and three Senior Guards (level 22).

Kill the guards first, then Sigmund. He will use protection prayers, but will use only protect from missiles in the second phase. You can safespot the guards using Zanik, and you can safespot Sigmund using the boxes. Make sure Zanik hits Sigmund before you do. This way, you will be able to damage him.
Smash the nearby drilling machine, then head down the southern tunnel to the exit. A cutscene will appear.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Enter the top floor of the Watchtower.
Talk to the Watchtower Wizard. Dialogue: "What's the matter?", "So how come the spell doesn't work?", "Can I be of help?"
Climb down 2 ladders and search the far north-west bush to find fingernails.
Talk to the Watchtower Wizard. Dialogue: "What do you suggest I do?", "So what do I do?"

route.title: Getting the relic pieces and the first crystal
steps: Talk to Og north-west of Yanille to receive Toban's key. Dialogue: "I seek entrance to the city of ogres."
Head south and get onto the island by using a rope with the branch (not the tree) of the long-branched tree that is west of the island.
Talk to Grew. Dialogue: "Don't eat me; I can help you."
Enter the hole south of Gu'Tanoth (the "Tunnel to Toban" on map above, dungeon icon south of Jiggig, and north-west of some ruins).
Kill Gorad and take his tooth (be sure to have room in your inventory or you won't receive the tooth).
Talk to Toban. Dialogue: "I seek entrance to the city of ogres.", "I could do something for you..."
Talk to Toban again with dragon bones in your inventory to receive Relic part 3.
Search the chest and take Toban's stolen gold.
Talk to Grew back on the Jangerberry island.
Go back and talk to Og.
Talk to the Watchtower Wizard, who will put the three relics together and give you an ogre relic.

route.title: The Skavids and the second crystal
steps: Enter Gu'Tanoth via the path on the north-east corner of the hills, then head west towards the gate. Enter by talking to the Ogre Guard with the ogre relic in your inventory.
Go south-east to the market in the central area and steal a rock cake from the counter on the southern side.
Go back to the upper walkway, then head around south until you encounter guards at a battlement. Climb the battlement. Dialogue: "But I am a friend to ogres..."
Talk to the guard again with the rock cake in your inventory.
Head north-east and attempt to jump the bridge, then agree to give the guards 20 coins. Dialogue: "Okay, I'll pay it."
Talk to a City guard. Dialogue: "I seek passage into the skavid caves."
Talk to a City guard again with a death rune in your inventory to receive a skavid map.
Return back across the bridges, over the battlement, and through the north-west gate where you entered the city.
Walk east, then turn south towards the second city gate.
Enter the Skavid caves just north of the gate.
Speak with the scared skavid. Dialogue: "Okay, okay, I'm not going to hurt you."
Exit the cave, and speak with each regular Skavid inside the following 4 caves:
The following responses should work. The first part is what the Skavid says. You must respond with the second part:
Exit the cave and go south to the Eastern City gate. Click on the gate to give a gold bar to the guard and gain access to the gate.
Continue past the gate and across the bridge into the cave. Speak to the Mad Skavid, who will say one of these options. Repeat with the second part again.
Take another cave nightshade. Make sure you have two of them. You can hop worlds for the second one.
Leave the way you came in (do <u>not</u> climb down the hole).
Return to the Gu'Tanoth market.
Use one nightshade on one of the Enclave guards (be sure to complete the dialogue).
Enter the cave and watch the cutscene.
Teleport out or run north to the exit.

route.title: The magic ogre potion
steps: Go back to the Watchtower wizard and talk to him.
To create a vial of water add in the <u>following order</u> (do not use the ground bat bones first or the water will evaporate and you will need more bones):
Talk to the Watchtower wizard again, with the unfinished potion in your inventory.

route.title: Getting the other crystals
steps: Prepare to defend yourself against the various ogres and a blue dragon in the Ogre Enclave. Don't forget your anti-dragon shield.
Return to the market square of Gu'Tanoth.
Use your nightshade on an Enclave guard to enter the cave again.
Use the magic ogre potion on all 6 ogre shamans to get the 3rd crystal.
Right-click mine the Rock of Dalgroth in the centre of the Enclave for the 4th crystal.
Talk to the Watchtower wizard and return the crystals. (Leave the room and return if crystals remain on pillars before you have placed them.)
Pull the lever to the west.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Building the statue
steps: Talk to Lazim north-east of the quarry. Dialogue: "Of course!", "Okay, I'll get on with it."
Bring him 32 kg of sandstone, it doesn't have to be all at once. You can break down big pieces with a chisel.
Use your chisel on the sandstone (32 kg).
Place the base on the flat ground.
Repeat the process for a 20 kg body.
Use your chisel on the statue.
Talk to Lazim and pick any head (remember which head you picked).
Mine two 5 kg pieces of granite (not sandstone!). (Ironmen: Mine a 3rd piece of any size for King's Ransom)
Make the head you chose (if you don't make the head you chose, you will have to make another head). The other 5 kg granite piece is used later.
If you did not bring clay or coal, mine some now.
Talk to him and you'll fall into a temple.

route.title: =Bottom floor=
steps: Talk to Lazim.
Use your chisel on the fallen statue four times to get all its limbs.
Talk to Lazim again to retrieve the statue head.
Take-sigil from the pedestal south of Lazim to get the M sigil.
Go around all the rooms through the outer hallways and pick up the R, K and Z sigils. The matching limbs are automatically used and consumed to open the doors.
Go to the centre room after collecting all four sigils
Try to open the doors to place the sigils. Make sure to complete each dialogue.
Climb the ladder.

route.title: =Middle floor=
steps: Use soft clay on the pedestal. (Cast a fire spell on the frozen fountain if you still need a water source.)
Use a chisel on the 5 kg granite.
Place the new stone head in the pedestal. The original head will be slightly too small. The new head should fit perfectly and trigger a cutscene (Make sure to finish dialogue).

North-west: use your bread or cake or pie on Pentyn. You may have to right-click again on Pentyn to make sure you are using the food on him and not on the magic spell. Dialogue: "It's okay, I don't need any help."
North-east: cast wind bolt, blast, wave, or surge on the furnace.
South-east: light the 6 braziers with the appropriate fuels.
South-west: cast fire bolt, blast, wave, or surge on the fountain.
Pass through the magic barrier and climb the ladder. (If you can't pass through barrier, talk to Lazim)

route.title: =Top floor=
steps: Cast crumble undead on the boneguard.
Climb down the stone ladder to the south.
Turn on Protect from Melee and talk to the new boneguard. Dialogue: "Of course, I'll help you out.", "Okay, I'll start building."
Take 3 sandstones from the rubble pile.
Use a sandstone on the southern wall, then use your chisel on the wall. Repeat to completion.
Talk to the boneguard again.
Congratulations, quest complete!
