route.title: Starting out
steps: Go to the Exam Centre south of the Digsite. (Varrock teleport then run east; or use a Digsite pendant/ teleport and walk south towards the exam centre; the Senntisten teleport from the Ancient Spellbook is quite close, and can be used from a Portal Nexus in a POH)
Search the most north-eastern of the south-eastern bookcases to find a beaten book.
Read the beaten book, then read the scroll.
Keep the book.

route.title: The second key
steps: Head back to the Anvil building in Seers Village and enter the odd-looking wall and down the staircase to the workshop.
Go north to the water elemental room and search the machinery to the west to get a key.
If you didn't bring 2 elemental ores with you, go west and get them by killing 2 Earth elementals (Mine the Elemental Rock for them to spawn).
Go south from the centre room and smelt your ores into bars, at the furnace.
Go down the hatch in the centre room with the key in your inventory.

route.title: =The crane=
steps: Take-from the schematic crate to the south, take both schematics.
Go back upstairs and use one bar on the workbench to make a crane claw. Note: Don't accidentally let it create more than one.
Return downstairs to the two crane levers and pull the western one to lower the crane.
Use your claw on the old crane.

route.title: =The junction box=
steps: Climb the stairs to the south-west to get on the catwalk.
Open the junction box to the west.
Click the pipe ends, not the pipe, to connect them as shown.

route.title: =Pipes and cogs=
steps: Search all crates on the ground floor and the catwalk of the workshop until you find the following. IMPORTANT: Be sure to read the Crane schematic and Lever schematic, or you will be unable to find all the pieces.
On the north side of the catwalk use the Pipe on the broken piping.
On the east side of the Ground floor use the cogs on the pins on the side of the machine that looks like a wind tunnel as shown.
Pull the old lever to the right.

route.title: =The crane=
steps: On the south side place an elemental bar on the jig cart. (under the elemental claw)
First, use the western lever (by the schematics crate) to raise the crane.
Use the eastern lever to rotate the crane.
Use the western lever twice to lower the crane into the lava and back up again.
Use the eastern lever to rotate the crane over the cart.
Use the western lever twice to lower the bar onto the cart and release it.
Pull the lever just north of the claw controls to move the cart.

route.title: =The press=
steps: Pull the western-most lever - in front of the press station - to flatten the bar once the cart has stopped.
Pull the yellow sign lever again to move the cart to the next station.

route.title: =The water tank=
steps: Pull the northern-most lever.
Turn the corkscrew lever twice.
Pull the northern-most lever again.
Turn the west water valve twice so that the valve opens and closes. The tank will fill.
Turn the east water valve twice so that the valve opens and closes. The tank will empty.
Pull the northern-most lever.
Turn the corkscrew lever twice.
Pull the northern-most lever to close the door.
Pull the yellow sign lever again.

route.title: =Drying=
steps: Pull the east lever
Pull the east lever again to stop the fan.
Pull the yellow sign lever again.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Take-from the jig to get a primed bar.
Head down the stairs to the north-west.
Go through the east door.
Use your primed bar with the extractor gun.
Operate the Extractor hat with the bar placed under the gun.
Take-from the extractor gun to get a primed mind bar.
Go up both spiral stairs
Use your primed mind bar on the workbench to smith a mind helmet.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Getting Started
steps: Talk to Ali Morrisane next to the Silk Stall in Al Kharid. Dialogue: "If you are, then why are you still selling goods from a stall?", "I'd like to help you but.....", "Yes.", "Okay."
Buy a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard and combine them.

route.title: Pollnivneach
steps: Head to Pollnivneach.
Use the 3 beers on Drunken Ali at the bar. (Make sure to use one beer on him, then talk to him in full, then use the second beer, talk in full, then finally the third beer, and talk in full.)
Talk to the bandits in Pollnivneach by the general store.
Go west of the bar and question the Menaphite Thugs.

route.title: Camels
steps: Head to the camel store just north-west of the bar.

Talk to Ali the Camel Man to buy the camels for 500 coins. You will need two free spaces in your inventory. Dialogue: "Are those camels around the side for sale?", "What price do you want for both of them?", "Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?"
Talk to a Menaphite and a bandit to give them each a receipt.

route.title: =Pickpocketing=
steps: Go to Ali the Operator and ask to join his gang (big purple tent, south-west)Dialogue: "Yes, of course, those bandits should be taught a lesson.", "No thanks."
Attempt to pickpocket a villager once then return to Ali the Operator. Dialogue: "Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice.", "No thanks."
Talk to the street urchin near the centre town well.
Pickpocket the villager with an arrow over their head.
Talk to Ali the Operator Dialogue: "Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice."
Equip the oak blackjack and then lure a villager into a secluded area.

route.title: =Jewels=
steps: Talk to Ali the Operator.
Put on the desert disguise and gloves.
Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house (the large house to the East by the fountain).
Use the keys on the door.
Go up the stairs in the north-eastern corner.
Search the landscape picture near the bed.
Hit the button on the dial to reset it.
Give the jewels to Ali the Operator.

route.title: =Traitor=
steps: Talk to Ali the Operator.
Talk to a Menaphite Thug.
Talk to Ali the Operator. Dialogue: "No thanks."
Talk to Ali the barman. Dialogue: "I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.", "No thanks I'm ok."
Buy special sauce from the kebab seller. He can be found north-west of the well in the middle of the town. Dialogue: "Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?", "No thanks, I'm good."
Use it on a trough behind the camel shop.
Use a bucket on the dung if it is brown. Obtain three more buckets of dung if you plan to complete My Arm's Big Adventure.

Use a coin on the snake charmer's money pot, sitting south of the bar Dialogue: "Wow, a snake charmer. Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?" with 2 free inventory spaces to get a snake charm and a snake basket.
Use the snake charm on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent until it goes into the snake basket.
Go to Ali the Hag north-west of the kebab seller. Talk to her twice to give her the snake basket and Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison in exchange.
Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.
Talk to Ali the Operator.

route.title: Dealing with the thugs
steps: Prepare for battle and talk to the Menaphite Leader (just outside the tent).
Kill the Tough Guy (level 75) (safespot behind bush). He drops a willow blackjack.
Talk to a villager. Dialogue: "Ok I'll get to it."
Talk to the Bandit Leader wandering around the northern magic carpet station.
Kill the bandit champion (level 70) (safespot behind chair in house to the east). He drops an adamant scimitar (if you have a willow blackjack in your inventory).
Talk to a villager.
Talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in village centre.
Return to Ali Morrisane (with whom you started the quest). Dialogue: "No, I'm really too busy."
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Digression
steps: Talk to Brimstail in the cave found in the south-west corner of the Gnome Stronghold. Dialogue: "What's that cute creature wandering around?", "Yes, that sounds fascinating...", "Oh, yes I love a bit of History.", "Of course!"

route.title: Elven Mystery
steps: Inspect the singing bowl in the western portion of the cave.
To the north, attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine.
Talk to Brimstail. Dialogue: "I've had a look in the other room now.", "Of course, I'd love to!"

route.title: Memories
steps: Talk to Hazelmere, located upstairs in his house (on the small island east of Yanille, fairy ring code goes directly to his house, Nightmare Zone minigame teleport or Watchtower Teleport). There will be several cutscenes, the last being King Healthorg and the white Spirit Tree Argento. You'll know you're done when you get a Violet pentagon in your backpack.
Return to Brimstail. Dialogue: "I've visited Hazelmere, he told me all sorts of interesting things."

route.title: Incapacitated
steps: Use your Mud Rune on the Pestle and Mortar to make Ground Mud Runes.
Add the Ground Mud Runes to the Bucket of Sap to make Magic glue.
Repair Oaknock's machine (click on the machine twice).
Talk to Brimstail. Dialogue: "I think I've fixed the machine now!"

route.title: Anti-Illusion
steps: Talk to Brimstail twice more to receive more discs. Dialogue: "I"
Optional: Drop the discs and talk to Brimstail to receive even more discs. Dialogue: "I can't work out what to do with these discs!"

route.title: Front Panel
steps: Head back to the Oaknock's machine and unlock the machine.

route.title: Control Panel
steps: Unlock the front panel by inserting a disc with a value equal to the green number. (When done, click the green box next to the number.)
Talk to Brimstail for more discs. Dialogue: "I"
Complete the three puzzles inside the unlocked machine
Talk to Brimstail. Dialogue: "Phew! I've got that machine working now. What do I need to do now?"

route.title: Assassination
steps: Talk to Brimstail again. Dialogue: "Phew! I've got that machine working now. What do I need to do now?"
Kill all Evil Creatures: (wait for the whole death animation to end before running or teleporting away!). Their colour is now black.
Talk to King Narnode.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: With one free inventory space, talk to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village. A gnome glider is nearby, as well as fairy ring . Dialogue: "Why do I need to run?", "Rashiliyia? Who is she?", "What can we do?", "I'll go to see the Shaman", "Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus."
Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai (quest icon on minimap). Fairy ring is nearby.

Follow the chat options once you've used the belt on him. Dialogue: "Mosol Rei said something about a legend?", "Do you know anything more about the temple?", "Tell me more.", "I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!", "Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help."

route.title: Ah Za Rhoon
steps: Head to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or Fairy ring , or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
Use your spade on the mound of earth.
Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure, then use your rope on the fissure. You will lose the item.
Search the fissure () to climb down and follow the cave south until you reach the stream.
Search the cave-in at 2 to enter a new cave. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll wriggle through."
Search the loose rocks at 6 to find a tattered scroll. Dialogue: "Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them." Read the scroll.
Search the sacks at 7 to find a crumpled scroll. Read the scroll.
Search the ancient gallows at 8 to get the Zadimus corpse. Dialogue: "Yes, I may find something else on the corpse."
Teleport out, or head back to the first area via the Cave in at 2.
Head to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus' hut and bury the corpse.

route.title: Tomb of Bervirius
steps: With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring . Climb the rocks () and then cross the bridge.
Search the well stacked rocks on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring (). If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the Tattered Scroll.

Head south and with at least 3 empty inventory spaces search the dolmen. If you had no space you'll have to return with charcoal and papyrus to get the notes. Do not drop the locating crystal or you will take 5-10 damage.
Use a chisel on the sword pommel to craft the bone beads.
Use bronze wire on the bone beads to create the Beads of the Dead necklace. You must read the Crumpled Scroll before you can create them.
Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).

route.title: Tomb of Rashiliyia
steps: Prepare for the fight against Nazastarool. Crumble Undead is useful alongside Protect from Melee.
With your three regular bones, bone shard and chisel, head south-east from fairy ring to the north-eastern dot on the Karamja map above.
Search the unique bright green palm tree from the north side to find two doors.
Search the doors to find the keyhole.
Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.
Equip the Beads of the Dead then use the key on the doors.
Open the ancient gate (while wearing the Beads of the Dead necklace), then climb down the rocks.
Run west, south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.
Use (don't bury) 3 regular bones on the doors (can kill skeletons, not zombies for the bones if you forgot).
Search the dolmen, then defeat Nazastarool in his 3 forms. If you click away from the dialogue at the end of each form, click on the dolmen again to resume the other phases.
Take the Rashiliyia corpse.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Return to Cairn Isle (fairy ring ).
Go through the well-stacked rocks.
Use the corpse on the dolmen.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Sneaking back
steps: To begin speak to Elena in East Ardougne (directly west of shortcut log). Dialogue: "I'll try to retrieve it for you."
Speak to Jerico in the house just south of the northern Ardougne bank (The house with pigeon cages in the backyard).
Search the cupboard to obtain bird feed (click continue or the bird feed won't be added to your inventory).
Grab a pigeon cage from the backyard (note: if you are planning on doing One Small Favour, grab an extra 5 pigeon cages).
Go south-west of Ardougne Castle and speak to Omart.
Go north to the small watchtower along the wall, in front of the gates to West Ardougne.
Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.
Use bird feed on the watchtower fence.
Click open on the pigeon cage in your inventory.
Equip your gas mask.
Run south from the watchtower and speak to Omart. Dialogue: "Ok, lets do it." After a slight delay, you will arrive in West Ardougne.

route.title: Infiltrating the Mourner Headquarters
steps: Head around the headquarters to the north-eastern area with the vat and mangle.
Squeeze through the fence into the backyard.
Pick up the rotten apple.
Use the rotten apple on the cauldron.
Go back through the fence.
Go to Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the West Ardougne church.
Search cupboard in northern part of the house for a medical gown.
Equip the medical gown, go back to the headquarters and open the door.
Go upstairs and kill a mourner. A key will automatically be placed in your inventory.
Use the key on the gate to get into the caged room.
Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator.

With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the sewers from the Plague City quest).

route.title: Getting the touch paper
steps: Go to the Chemist in south-western Rimmington (you can take a ship from Captain Barnaby at the Ardougne Dock directly to Rimmington for 30gp or use a teleport as the vials won't break upon teleportation anymore)
Speak to the Chemist. Dialogue: "Your quest." He will give you the touch paper.

route.title: Foresight
steps: You will find Chancy, Da Vinci and Hops around a fire outside the Chemist's house.
Give Chancy the . Dialogue: "You give him the vial of liquid honey..."
Give Da Vinci the . Dialogue: "You give him the vial of ethenea..."
Give Hops the . Dialogue: "You give him the vial of sulphuric broline..."

route.title: So far, so good
steps: Teleport or travel to Varrock.

Travel to the fenced area to the south-east of the bank (south-eastern Varrock). The guard will search you, but you will be able to pass freely with the plague sample and touch paper in your inventory.

(Optional) Speak to Asyff, the Fancy dress shop owner, in the building south-east, to get a free priest gown (top and bottom) and equip it. Alternatively, purchase a priest gown (top and bottom) from him and equip it.
Go to the Dancing Donkey Inn.
Talk to Hops, Da Vinci and Chancy to get the vials back. Make sure you have the free inventory space.

route.title: Secrets
steps: With your Priest gown equipped head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.
Speak to Guidor, tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed. Dialogue: "I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague."
Return to Ardougne and speak to Elena.
Go to the of Ardougne Castle and speak to King Lathas. Dialogue: "I don't understand..."
Congratulations, quest complete!

Pickpocket him for the zealot's key.

steps: Go down the ladder directly east.

route.title: Cave level 3
steps: Avoid touching mine carts.
Go south along the moving cart's tracks using the alcove for cover, then slightly west.
Climb down the ladder.

route.title: Cave level 4
steps: Pick a glowing fungus. Don't take any random events that teleport you out of the mine from now on or your fungus will turn to ash.
Go NW and place the fungus in the searchable cart.
Go NW to check the points settings. (Board on a wall)
Write down which levers need to change to match the correct setting to get to the ladder in the top-right corner.
Go south-east and pull the needed levers (between A-E).
Go north-west and pull the needed levers (between F-K).
Return to the point settings and click start.

route.title: Finding the cart again
steps: Leave the cave by going back the way you came
Crawl-down the Cart tunnel to the north
Climb down the nearby ladder.
Go NE and climb down the ladder by the door.
Go west then north and climb down the ladder.
Search the cart for the fungus and take it. Do not drop until you have completed the quest!

route.title: Water valve
steps: Climb up the ladder and start saving your run energy after you turn the water valve in the next step.
Go all the way east then south past the moving cart.
Climb down the ladder.
Head south and use the Zealot's key on the water valve.
Quickly run to the lift and take it down.
Go south then East and down the stairs.
Go through the door.
Pick up the innocent-looking key to start the boss fight.

Kill Treus Dayth. It is recommended to pray Protect from Missiles throughout the fight. A good way to fight this boss is to run near him after attacking; the goal is to force him into the north-eastern corner. Once this occurs, run west to the end of the detached northern shaft and attack him from a distance. This prevents him from teleporting around the mine while also negating crane damage, which should make the fight easier.
Pick up the key
Go back up the eastern stairs.
Go west and down those stairs. You will need the Glowing fungus to act as a light source.
Open the door and cut the crystal outcrop to the south-east with your chisel.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Effigy south of East Ardougne (south-west of fairy ring , Ardougne cloak monastery teleport and walk east, or minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler and walk north) to begin the quest. Dialogue: "Sure, why not."
Talk to Bonafido at the tower's entrance. He will ask to get a builder's costume.
Wear the full costume. Talk to Bonafido and answer his questions. Dialogue: "Tea", "Whistle for attention", "Your legs are getting a bit cold", "Carry on, it'll fix itself"
Enter the tower while still wearing the full costume

route.title: =Fix the pressure machine=
steps: Take the following supplies (by searching the crates inside the tower):
Head up the first staircase on the west side of the tower.
Fix the pressure machine on the north side of the room.
Complete the puzzle (turn the valves until all holes are plugged, pull the levers when necessary).

Once all the holes are plugged, make sure to turn the valves until all of the pipes are filled with water. You should see a message that says "The machine is working!" when you have completed the puzzle.

route.title: =Fix the pipe machine=
steps: Take the following supplies:
Head up two floors.
Fix the pipe machine on the south side of the room. You should see a message that says "The machine is working!" when you have completed the puzzle.

route.title: =Fix the cage=
steps: Take the following supplies:
Head up to the top floor of the tower.
Fix the cage.
Complete the puzzle. You should see a message that says "The cage is complete!" when you have completed the puzzle.

route.title: =Finishing up=
steps: Talk to Effigy.
Go to the top floor for a cutscene involving the alchemists and the Homunculus.
Go outside to talk to Effigy.
Return to the top floor and answer the Homunculus' questions until the bar is filled with either 'Logic' or 'Magic'.
Talk to Effigy again.
Go to the dungeon floor inside the tower via the trapdoor to the south and talk to the Homunculus to the north.
Optional: Medium Ardougne Diary task - kill a "swordchick" (requires 1 raw swordfish and 1 raw chicken.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to Patzi to start the quest (fairy ring (), then walk east).
Break into the house north of Patzi, west of the general store, via the southern House Window. Wait for the guard to move away.
Take uniform from the wardrobe on the ground floor
Speak to Patzi again
Equip both pieces of the uniform.
Head east up the stone steps, then south and speak to the Head Butler to enter the house. He will hold onto all of your items in the meantime.
Speak to Patzi
Speak to Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo and Xocotla
Speak with Patzi again
Enter the cellar entrance. It is located just outside of the house, immediately north of the house's east exit.
Go all the way south and investigate the Antique wine against the wall.
Check on the man on the south end of the room to the east.
Speak to Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo and Xocotla.
Head back inside the wine cellar and investigate:
Speak to the guards Stradius and Hutza to discuss your clues.
Pickpocket Adala, Patzi, Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo and Xocotla.
Inspect the Wine labels, Threatening note, Shipping contract and Drinking flask
Speak to one of the guards, either Stradius or Hutza.
Speak to all the suspects, then accuse Adala, and she'll fight you (level 49). Once defeated, she'll claim she's too weak to have killed anyone.
Once Adala has been taken away, speak to Stradius, then head back to the ground floor, south to the cliff, round and climb up the Loose rocks shortcut, and speak to Stradius again.
Head down the stairs to the east, enter the backstage entrance, and question the Costumer.
Search the crate next to the stairs to discover it is full of poison.
Search the bookshelf on the west wall to uncover a secret passage to the wine cellar.
Search the costume rack along the north wall to discover a wine-stained costume.
Ask the Costumer about the actors, hidden passage, stained costume and the poison.
Go up the stairs and speak to Stradius again. Accuse Naiatli.
Confront Naiatli on stage and attack her when she runs away.
Speak to Stradius or Hutza to end the quest.
Speak to the Head Butler after the quest to claim a range of masks, and the Butler's tray.
Speak to the Costumer after the quest to claim your Costume needle.
Pickpocket Constantinius for a chest key. After using it to open the fancy chest in the south room of the cellar, the fountain to the south-west of Villa Lucens can be searched to find an icon.
Use the icon on the statue at the most north-eastern tip of Aldarin (Statue Holds bowl of blue fluid), and get your reward. (1 water rune, Pendant of Ates teleport location)

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Start the quest by searching the tent for Kasonde's journal (Fairy ring with code and head south east). Dialogue: "Yes."
Read the journal.
Search the camping equipment to receive secateurs.
Climb down the nearby hole.
Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the first stone tablet.
Read the stone tablet and take the note to receive the word translations scroll. Dialogue: "Yes."
Read the word translations scroll and click "Attempt Translation". Input the following words and press enter for each: Island, Water, Time, Vessel, North.
Chat will show a prompt about having translated enough once you enter all words. The hole on Molch Island will not appear if any words are missing.
Climb-up the rope to exit the hole.
Travel to Lake Molch via Boaty and select Molch Island. (Fairy ring with code and head west.) Dialogue: "Molch Island"
Enter the hole on Molch Island.
Inspect the vines for a dirty note.
Cut the vines with your secateurs and squeeze through them.
Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the second stone tablet.
Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: West, Poison, Body, Food, Earth.
Climb-up the rope to exit the hole.
Travel to Xeric's Shrine.
Enter the hole at Xeric's Shrine.
Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the third stone tablet.
Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: Make, Yes, No, Move, Arrive, East, South.
Make your way to the Ruins of Morra. Enter the hole there.
Search the stone table labelled "1" in the image below to receive the final stone tablet.
Read the stone tablet, then input the following words on the word translations scroll: Few, Big, Sun, Moon, Life, Death, Mind, Home, Air, Fire.
Read the stone tablet again and then read the warning note.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Speak to Guildmaster Apatura in the Hunters' Guild. Dialogue: "Can I help you with anything?"
Go down the stairs in the big tree in the middle of Hunters' Guild.
Speak to Guild Scribe Verity behind the bar.
Talk to Guild Hunter Wolf (Master) just west of the bar to get a toy mouse.
Wind up the toy mouse and then use it on Guild Hunter Kiko to distract him.
Check Kiko's cat bed.
Return to Wolf and talk to her again.
Buy a box trap from Imia's Supplies if you do not have one. Pick up the needle spawn in the fur shop for later use.
Go back up the stairs and head south-east from the guild towards the mine to find Guild Hunter Fox laying down. He can be found south-east of the mining symbol (south-west of Fairy Ring )
Talk to Fox.
Take a leaf from the leafy bush. The bush is south-west of him and browner than the other bushes.
Go east to the Locus Oasis and pick from the rough-looking bush for a second leaf. The bush is south of the hunter symbol on the map, on the west coast of the oasis.
While here, catch two Embertailed jerboa using a box trap for their tails.
Use the Jerboa tail on the leaves to create Makeshift poultice.
Return to Fox and talk to him again.
Head to Atza, who is in one of the buildings just east of the southern gate of Civitas illa Fortis (west of the pub). Talk to her.
Set-up the pile of equipment in the middle of the room. (A hammer is available in the house to the north.)
Talk to Atza to get the trimmed fur.
Return to Fox. He will give you a report for the guild.
Return to Guild Scribe Verity, down the stairs in the Hunter Guild, and give her the report.
Use the remaining jerboa tail on the cat bed to fix it.
Head back upstairs, and talk to Guildmaster Apatura.
Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Rat Burgiss at the crossing south of Varrock. Dialogue: "Shall I get them back for you?", "Of course! Tell me what you need me to do."
Kill 5 Outlaws just west of the Grand Exchange (from Grand Exchange, use the tunnel and walk south) and collect 5 rat's paper.
Fill the folder with 5 papers.
Return the folder to Rat Burgiss.
Talk to Surok Magis in the Varrock library (the northern-most room in Varrock Palace). Dialogue: "Go on, then!"
Read Sin'keth's diary.
Enter the Chaos Altar and use the wand on the altar with 15 chaos runes in your inventory.
Return to Surok Magis with the infused wand and an empty bowl. Dialogue: "I have the things you wanted!"
Talk to Rat Burgiss. Dialogue: "Yes! I have a letter for you!"
Talk to Zaff. Dialogue: "Rat Burgiss sent me!"
Talk to Surok Magis. Dialogue: "Bring it on!"
Bring King Roald to low health (2 hitpoints or less) then operate the Beacon ring. Your chatbox will show "Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!" when the ring is ready to be operated. (Instanced)
Talk to Rat Burgiss.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to Brundt in the longhall to start the quest. (Fairy ring and run south-west to Rellekka) Dialogue: "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!", or Dialogue: "Ask about anything else.", "Do you have any quests?", "Yes, I am interested.", "I want to become a Fremennik!" if started or finished Mountain Daughter
The trials may be done in any order, however this quick guide will show you the fastest order.

route.title: Manni the Reveller, Sigli the Huntsman, and Olaf the Bard
steps: Talk to Manni the Reveller while in the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Take the keg of beer and challenge Manni to a drinking contest. You will lose. Dialogue: "Yes"
If you did not bring a beer, grab the beer tankard now.
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman outside, near the entrance of the longhall, to obtain the Hunters' Talisman. Dialogue: "What's a Draugen?", "Yes"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to Olaf again. Dialogue: "I don't need a reminder"
To get a lyre, either make it yourself (Requires and 6 free inventory spaces) or kill Lanzig (1/17 drop rate). Killing lanzig takes longer on average. You must enchant it either way.

route.title: Seers' Village
steps: Teleport to Camelot or walk to Seers' Village.
If you are making the lyre yourself:
Go to the Seers' Village pub and talk to the Poison Salesman to buy a low alcohol keg for 250 coins. Dialogue: "Talk about the Fremennik Trials", "Yes"
Buy a regular beer if you forgot to take a beer tankard. Dialogue: "Beer please."

route.title: Back to Rellekka
steps: Use a Rellekka house teleport to return, or simply walk back. If walking, left-click on your talisman to check if The Draugen is nearby on your way. If so, kill him.
Use the beer, or beer tankard, on the council workman by the bridge south of Rellekka to obtain strange object.
Go north across the bridge, then walk a bit west until you see a small narrow path heading south into the water. (The large rib cage sticking out of the water on the left side of the bridge)
Use your raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar to enchant your lyre.
Follow your talisman by left-clicking on it and kill The Draugen now if you haven't already. Appears as a grey butterfly before locating the correct tile.
Once done, head back into Rellekka and talk to Sigli at the entrance.
Head to the outside of the longhall to the pipe on the eastern wall. Use a tinderbox on your strange object and use the lit strange object on the pipe.
Enter the north-eastern back door of the longhall, walk onto the stage, and play your enchanted lyre.
Exit the back door, enter the main long hall, and take a keg of beer off the table.
Use your low alcohol keg on the keg of beer.
Challenge Manni to a drinking contest again. Dialogue: "Yes"

route.title: Sigmund the Merchant and Swensen the Navigator
steps: Talk to Sigmund The Merchant in the market west of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Talk to the Sailor on the docks to the north-west. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Olaf the Bard just east of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Yrsa at the clothing store west of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"

Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial" or Dialogue: "Ask about anything else", "Ask about the Merchant's trial" if you are doing or have finished Mountain Daughter
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman just south of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Skulgrimen in the hut just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to the Fisherman north of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Swensen the Navigator in the building south of the market. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Swensen again. Dialogue: "Ask about becoming a Fremennik", "Yes"
Climb down the ladder and take the South, West, East, North, South, East, then North portals. Climb up the ladder.
Talk to Peer the Seer just north-west of Swensen. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior in the hut just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Thora the Barkeep in the longhall. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial"
Talk to Askeladden in front of the longhall, pay him 5,000 coins. Dialogue: "Ask about the Merchant's trial", "Yes"
Head back and talk to (in order):

route.title: Thorvald the Warrior
steps: Go to a bank (The Seers' Village bank is close) and deposit all of your items (you cannot have any weapons, armour, or runes).
Bring equipment for the fight:
Talk to Thorvald just north of the longhall. Dialogue: "Yes"
Climb down the ladder. If you have a knife and dramen branch, cut it into a staff and equip it. You can also use celastrus bark to fletch a battlestaff.

Fight the first 3 forms of Koschei the Deathless without weapons, armour, or runes. (You can pray flick him for the first 3 forms. Dying in the room is safe, even for regular Hardcore Ironmen). Do not go up the ladder after completing the 3rd form - it is safe to die from the 4th form.

You can choose to let the 4th form kill you (this is safe for Group Hardcore Ironmen as Koschei will not actually finish you in this form; the player will faint and wake up upstairs rather than being killed), or you can kill it (slower and is not necessary).
Talk to Thorvald again.

route.title: Peer the Seer
steps: Talk to Peer the Seer south-west of the market. Dialogue: "Yes", "Yes"
Open the door to his house, south-west of the market (with a green bed), and read the riddle.
Each line of the riddle gives you one letter of a four-letter word. See the table below for the first riddle line and the related answer.
Open the door again and climb-up the ladder.
Search/study these objects to get a bucket, red disk, wooden disk, jug, and red herring:
Use the red herring on the cooking range.
Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk.
Open the trapdoor on the east side, climb-down the trapdoor, and use the two red disks on the abstract mural.
Return upstairs and use the bucket on the tap by the cooking range.
Use the full bucket on the jug.
Use the jug on the drain.
Use the 2/5ths bucket on the empty jug.
Refill the bucket.
Use the full bucket on the 2/3rds jug.
Use the 4/5ths bucket on the northern chest with the scale.
Fill the vase with water and add the lid.
Use the sealed vase on the frozen table.
Use the frozen key on the cooking range.
Climb-down the eastern trapdoor, and you can now open the door to leave.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Treasure trail
steps: Return to the tree and dig next to it.
Go all the way east in the tunnel and then north.
(Optional): Kill a brine rat here to complete a Fremennik Medium Diary achievement (requires 47 Slayer).
Kill a skeleton fremennik and pick up the key it drops.

Search the wall again to walk through.

Go to the bridge to the north-east and use the barrels on the missing portions; a higher level Agility helps (If you fall, you will need to go through the cave again.) (Recommended: stamina potions.)
Open the gate.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Search the chest located in the old ship and kill Ulfric (level 100, uses melee).
Search the chest again.
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Climb down the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.
Search the wall and enter the cave entrance just south-east.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz. Dialogue: "I want to join your organisation."

route.title: Patching up Burgh De Rott
steps: Talk to Florin through the gate to Burgh de Rott.
Put a piece of food into the open chest, then open the gate.
Talk to Razvan near the pub. Dialogue: "Are there any 'out of the way' places in here?"
Enter the pub, climb over the broken wall, then use your pickaxe on the rubble blocking the trapdoor.
Climb down and mine the rest of the rubble. Anything you drop in the basement will be lost upon leaving.
Use your spade on the remnants to fill the buckets. There is enough here to fill five buckets.
When finished, use the buckets of rubble on the rubble pile outside the pub.
Talk to Razvan again. Dialogue: "I'd like to help fix up the town."
Talk to Aurel in the general store to the north-east. Dialogue: "I'd like to help fix up the town."
Climb up the ladder right outside.
Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the broken roof of the store.
Climb back down and Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall of the general store.
Talk to Aurel again to get a crate. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Add 10 bronze axes, 10 raw mackerels or 10 snails (depending on what is asked), and 3 tinderboxes to the crate.
Talk to Aurel.
Talk to Cornelius in the bank. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Use a hammer with 2 planks, 1 swamp paste, and 8 nails on the broken bank booth
Use a hammer with 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall outside.
Talk to Cornelius to recruit him. Dialogue:

route.title: Defending the village
steps: Talk to Razvan. Dialogue: "What should I do now?"
Repair the furnace to the south-east. Use your steel bars, then coal, then tinderbox on the furnace.
Talk to Gadderanks in the general store.
Talk to the Vampyre Juvinate in the store.
Talk to Wiskit.
Kill the two juvinates and then Gadderanks (you'll need a silver weapon or Wolfbane dagger or Efaritay's aid to damage them).
Talk to Gadderanks.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.

route.title: Transporting Ivan
steps: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the hideout where the quest started. (The room under the Canifis pub)
Talk to Polmafi Ferdygris.
Talk to Ivan Strom to go on a simplified version of Temple Trekking and take either the short or long route. (you can't bring a pet - it must be banked!)
Kill the Vampyre Juvinates before they can kill Ivan Strom.

After you're done escorting Ivan, talk to Drezel in the underground temple for a key. Dialogue: "Veliaf told me about Ivandis.", "Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis?", "The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!"
Use the key on the keyhole on the eastern wall and climb down the trapdoor.
Search the bookcases in the hidden room until you find The sleeping seven (The title of the book at the top when reading it is "The Sleeping Seven"). Read it.

route.title: The rod of Ivandis
steps: Return to the room under the Canifis pub, then go to the blockaded cave entrance just south-east of the wall.
Use a hammer on the wooden boards and enter the cave.
Use your soft clay on the coffin to make a rod mould.
Go to any furnace with your mould, a silver bar, a mithril bar and a sapphire, and craft a silvthrill rod. (Fairy ring for Edgeville Furnace.)
Cast Lvl-1 Enchant on the rod.
Use the rod on the well underneath the Paterdomus Temple (where Drezel was) with a rope in your inventory. (Nearest fairy ring )

Return to the Burgh de Rott pub basement with the Rod of Ivandis (it must be in your inventory, not equipped), then speak to Veliaf. Dialogue: "I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis!", "Yes, I've come to give the Rod of Ivandis to you!"
Congratulations, quest complete!

route.title: Starting off
steps: Inspect Pirate Pete.
Talk to the cook in the next room about protecting the pirate. Dialogue: "Protecting the Pirate"

Go through all 5 chat options. Dialogue: "Where do I get Ground Cod?", "Where do I get Ground Kelp?", "Where do I get Ground Giant Crab Meat?3", "Where do I get Breadcrumbs?", "What do I do with all of it?", "Thanks!"
Use your pestle and mortar on the raw cod.
Use your knife on the bread to make breadcrumbs.
Talk to Murphy in Port Khazard. Dialogue: "Talk about Recipe for Disaster." (Fishing Trawler minigame teleport is the easiest way to get there - requires 15 Fishing)
Talk to Murphy again. Dialogue: "Yes, Let's go diving."

route.title: Under the Sea
steps: Equip your fishbowl helmet and diving apparatus, Bring the needle and three bronze wire. Agree to go diving.
Pick some kelp. (It's highly recommended to pick at least 3 kelp as the fishcake can burn).
Go north and talk to Nung.
Go west and pick up 5 rocks, then enter the cave.
Kill 5 mudskippers (level 30/31) for 5 hides.
Talk to Nung twice.
Enter the crab pen, kill a crab and take its meat. (It's highly recommended to get at least 3 Crab meat as the fishcake can burn).
Grind the kelp and crab meat with a pestle and mortar.
Teleport away, or go south and climb the anchor
Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge about freeing the pirate again. Dialogue: "Protecting the Pirate"
Use the ingredients on each other then cook the fishcake.
Give the fishcake to Pirate Pete in Lumbridge.
Congratulations, section complete!

route.title: Starting out
steps: Inspect Skrach Uglogwee in the Lumbridge Castle dining room. Dialogue: "Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy."
Talk to Rantz in the Feldip Hills (fairy ring AKS, then east). Dialogue: "I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?", "Ok, I'll do it."
Go south-east to the coast and talk to Rantz again. Dialogue: "Ok, here I am... I guess this is the watery place? What now?"
Use your axe on the fallen tree twice, then talk to Rantz again. Dialogue: "Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly?"

route.title: The cooked chompy
steps: Board the ogre boat to Karamja and find the tree with an arrow in it on the west coast, west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Light a fire next to the tree, use your iron spit on the raw chompy, then cook it on the fire.
Board the ogre boat back and talk to Rantz on the coast. Dialogue: "Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!"

route.title: The Jubbly
steps: Fill your ogre bellows at the swamp bubbles and inflate a toad in the nearby swamp.
Mine a rock from the pile of rocks east of Rantz's cave.
Use the ogre bellows on the bloated toad with a ball of wool in your inventory to make a balloon toad.
Drop the balloon toad in the dark area south of Rantz's cave and kill the level 9 Jubbly with your ogre bow and ogre arrows.
Pluck the Jubbly, pick up the raw jubbly and cook it on Rantz's spit-roast. If you burn it, make another balloon toad.
Give the cooked jubbly to Skrach Uglogwee in Lumbridge Castle to finish.

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to Timfraku upstairs in the western hut north of Tai Bwo Wannai. Dialogue: "I am a wandering wayfarer.", "Trufitus sent me.", "So far??", "Yes".
With your small fishing net, catch at least 23 raw karambwanji at the fishing spots just south of Tai Bwo Wannai.

Talk to Lubufu at the fishing spots south of the Brimhaven house portal. Dialogue: "I wasn't going anywhere...", then "Talk about him...", "What do you do?", "How old are you?", "I could help collect the bait.", "You sound like you could do with the help."
Talk to him again to give him 20 raw karambwanji, then again: "What do you use to catch Karambwan?", "What do you do with your Karambwan?", and accept his offer to receive a karambwan vessel.
Drop the vessel and ask Lubufu for another ("Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel."), then pick up the first, so that you have two.

route.title: Preparing the gifts
steps: Slice a banana with your knife and use the sliced banana on the Karamjan rum (bought from Zembo in Musa Point for 30 coins).
Light a fire with logs and a tinderbox, use the jogre bones on it and wait for the fire to go out; pick up the burnt jogre bones.
Use the pestle and mortar on one raw karambwanji to make karambwanji paste, and use the paste on the burnt jogre bones.
Cook the pasty jogre bones on a fire to make marinated jogre bones. Do not bury them.
Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, grind it with the pestle and mortar and use the karambwan paste on your iron spear.

route.title: Helping the brothers
steps: Go to Tiadeche, north-east of fairy ring DKP, and pick up the seaweed nearby. Talk to him.
Use a raw karambwanji on a karambwan vessel, then use the baited vessel on Tiadeche. Dialogue: "Yes".
Go to Tamayu at the mine north-east of fairy ring CKR. Talk to him twice and watch the cutscene. Dialogue: "When will you succeed?", "Yes".
Use the agility potion(4) and your karambwan-poisoned spear on Tamayu; make sure he takes both.
Talk to him again and watch him kill the Shaikahan. Dialogue: "Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan."
Kill a nearby level 3 monkey with Wind Strike and pick up its corpse; melee does no damage to it.
Use the corpse on Tamayu to get a monkey skin, and use the seaweed on the skin to make a seaweed sandwich.
Go to Cairn Isle, west of fairy ring CKR, climb the rocks and cross the bridge. Talk to Tinsay and give him the banana rum, seaweed sandwich and marinated jogre bones. Dialogue: "Yes."
Use your remaining karambwan vessel, empty or baited, on Tinsay to receive a crafting manual.
Return to Tiadeche near fairy ring DKP, talk to him, then use the manual on him.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Return to Timfraku and talk to him to complete the quest. Dialogue: "Oh it was nothing really."

Talk to each brother in his house in southern Tai Bwo Wannai for the extra rewards: Tiadeche 5,000 Fishing XP, Tinsay 5,000 Cooking XP and karambwan cooking, Tamayu 2,500 Attack and 2,500 Strength XP and a karambwan-poisoned rune spear.

route.title: Starting out
steps: Talk to Father Reen outside Al Kharid bank. Dialogue: "That's me!"
Travel to the Ruins of Uzer: take the magic carpet south of Al Kharid (Shantay pass needed), or use fairy ring DLQ and go north-east.
Talk to Father Badden near the ruin entrance. Dialogue: "Reen sent me.", "So what do you want me to do?", "How can I do that?" Be sure to have Silverlight in your inventory.

Pick 3 black mushrooms beside the staircase. Use one on Silverlight to dye it black; grind the others with the pestle and mortar and a vial each into 2 black dyes, and dye your desert shirt and desert robe.
Go down the stairs and grab a copy of the Strange implement in the north-west corner of the ruin.
Wearing the black desert shirt, black desert robe, black cape and the dyed Silverlight, talk to Evil Dave in the dungeon. Dialogue: "I want to join your group.", "I'm evil!"

route.title: Ritual
steps: Talk to Denath on the other side of the portal. Dialogue: "What do I have to do?"
Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. Dialogue: "Do you have the demonic sigil mould?"
Talk to Matthew. Dialogue: "Do you know what happened to Josef?"
Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil (use silver bar on furnace and select 'demonic sigil').
Your black outfit can now be discarded and replaced with combat gear (keep Silverlight with you).
Head back to Uzer and talk to the clay golem outside about last night. Dialogue: "Did you see anything happen last night?"
Search the nearby kilns for a book (there are four kilns – the last two are on the east side of the ruin, and by the magic carpet).
Read the book, and take it to Matthew on the other side of the portal

Go north and talk to Denath. Dialogue: "I forgot the incantation." (or Dialogue: "I forgot the incantation." during the ritual). Write down the incantation he tells you as it is used twice during the quest.
Complete the circle and click the sigil in your inventory to chant the incantation (unequip the Silverlight if nothing happens).
Take the demonic sigil Denath dropped on the floor. If you do not, you will have to create another demonic sigil.
Enter the portal to exit the room and take Tanya's sigil.
Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair Dialogue: "You've got to get back to the throne room!" – you should have 4 sigils now.

route.title: Rallying the troops
steps: Talk to Father Badden outside.
Convince Father Reen to join the ritual. Dialogue: "Oh, don't be so simple-minded!"
Talk to the golem, he will refuse to help. Dialogue: "I could just reprogram you again."
Use the Strange implement on the golem to reprogram him.
Talk to the golem again to make him enter the dungeon.

route.title: The final fight
steps: Talk to Matthew to start the incantation, say it backwards. Dialogue: "Yes"
Kill Agrith Naar (level 100) with any weapon, but the final blow must be with Silverlight. The demon heals if you run away while the final blow is being dealt.
Unequip Silverlight.
Choose your reward to finish the quest.
Congratulations, quest complete!
